

1. Importing libraries and functions
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(patchwork)
library(readxl)

```
Importing a function
```{r}
# =====================================================
# FUNCTION: HYBRID DETECTION ERROR METRICS
# =====================================================

make_error_metrics <- function(data, configuration, K) {

  data %>%
    mutate(
      pop = as.character(pop),

      data_type = case_when(
        pop %in% c("F1", "BC1w", "BC2w") ~ "Empirical",
        grepl("^Sim-(F1|BC1w|BC2w)(_|$)", pop) ~ "Simulated",
        grepl("^W-", pop) ~ "Empirical",
        grepl("^Sim-W-", pop) ~ "Simulated",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),

      true_group = case_when(
        pop %in% c("F1", "BC1w", "BC2w") ~ "Hybrid",
        grepl("^Sim-(F1|BC1w|BC2w)(_|$)", pop) ~ "Hybrid",
        grepl("^W-", pop) ~ "Wolf",
        grepl("^Sim-W-", pop) ~ "Wolf",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),

      predicted_hybrid = hy_verdict %in%
        c("BC2d", "BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w"),

      sample_group = case_when(
        # Empirical hybrids: all combined
        data_type == "Empirical" & true_group == "Hybrid" ~ "Hybrids",

        # Empirical wolves: separate Slovenia and Croatia
        data_type == "Empirical" & pop == "W-Slovenia" ~ "Slovenia",
        data_type == "Empirical" & pop == "W-Croatia" ~ "Croatia",
        data_type == "Empirical" & true_group == "Wolf" ~ "Other wolves",

        # Simulated populations in analysis 4a
        data_type == "Simulated" & configuration == "4a_wolves_hybrids" &
          grepl("_CRO$", pop) ~ "CRO",
        data_type == "Simulated" & configuration == "4a_wolves_hybrids" ~ "Other",

        # Simulated populations in all other analyses: combined
        data_type == "Simulated" ~ "Simulated",

        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(true_group), !is.na(sample_group)) %>%
    group_by(seed, data_type, sample_group) %>%
    summarise(
      n_hybrids = sum(true_group == "Hybrid"),
      n_wolves = sum(true_group == "Wolf"),

      false_negatives = sum(
        true_group == "Hybrid" & !predicted_hybrid
      ),

      false_positives = sum(
        true_group == "Wolf" & predicted_hybrid
      ),

      FNR = ifelse(n_hybrids > 0,
                   100 * false_negatives / n_hybrids, NA_real_),

      FPR = ifelse(n_wolves > 0,
                   100 * false_positives / n_wolves, NA_real_),

      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      configuration = configuration,
      K = K
    )
}

#Making empty list
accuracy_results <- list()
```

2.Analysing results after STRUCTURE and CLUMPAK

2.1 Slovenia–Croatia dataset without reference populations
1a) Using only empirical data confirmed with SNP analyses

Visualisation - density plot, heatmap
```{r}
# ------------------------------------------
# CONFIGURATION
# ------------------------------------------
seeds <- 1:1
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/1a_NDinaric_empirical"

# Create R_results folder if it does not exist
dir.create(
  file.path(base_dir, "R_results"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog")
)

# colour palette for all plots

color_map <- c(
  "Dog"="#999999","Sim-Dog"="#cccccc",
  "W-Croatia" =  "blue", "W-Slovenia" =  "blue","Sim-W-Croatia"="lightblue",
  "F1"="orange", "BC1w" ="red",  "BC2w"="violet"
)

pop_levels <- c(
"Dog","Sim-Dog",
  "F1","BC1w",  "BC2w", "W-Slovenia",
  "W-Croatia"
)
# ------------------------------------------
# LOOP THROUGH SEEDS
# ------------------------------------------
for (seed in seeds) {
  cat("\n=== Seed", seed, "===\n")

  folder <- base_dir
  input_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("1a_NDinaric_empirical.txt"))
  pop_file   <- file.path(folder, paste0("1a_NDinaric_empirical_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")
  
  
  # --- load data
  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input <- read.table(input_file, skip=1, as.is=TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header=FALSE, sep=" ", as.is=TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:7])
  structure_results$V2 <- as.character(structure_results$V2)
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)


structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend, by = c("Pop" = "id"))

  # ------------------------------------------------
  # FORCE POP ORDER FOR LEGEND 
  # ------------------------------------------------
 structure_results$pop <- factor(
    structure_results$pop,
    levels = pop_levels
  )

  # --- compute reference means and thresholds
  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% c("Dog","Sim-Dog",
                       "F1","BC1w",   "BC2w", "W-Slovenia",
                      "W-Croatia", "Sim-W-Croatia"))
   thresholds_adj <- c(
  BC2d  = 0.94,
  BC1d  = 0.83,
  F1    = 0.64,
  BC1w  = 0.32,
  BC2w  = 0.12,
  Wolf  = 0.05)
  

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_wolf   <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  # --- classify samples
structure_results_categories <- structure_results %>%
  mutate(across(c(Dog, N_Dinaric), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(
    hy_verdict = case_when(
      Dog >= thresh_BC2d        ~ "Dog",
      Dog >= thresh_BC1d        ~ "BC2d",
      Dog >= thresh_F1          ~ "BC1d",
      Dog >= thresh_BC1w        ~ "F1",
      Dog >= thresh_BC2w        ~ "BC1w",
      Dog >= thresh_wolf        ~ "BC2w",
      TRUE                      ~ "Wolf"
  ))

  # ------------------------------------------
  # PLOT 1: DENSITY PLOT
  # ------------------------------------------
  thresholds_df <- data.frame(
  value = c(
    thresh_wolf,
    thresh_BC2w,
    thresh_BC1w,
    thresh_F1,
    thresh_BC1d,
    thresh_BC2d
  ),
  label = c(
    paste0("wolf < ", round(thresh_wolf, 3), " > BC2w"),
    paste0("BC2w < ", round(thresh_BC2w, 3), " > BC1w"),
    paste0("BC1w < ", round(thresh_BC1w, 3), " > F1"),
    paste0("F1 < ", round(thresh_F1, 3), " > BC1d"),
    paste0("BC1d < ", round(thresh_BC1d, 3), " > BC2d"),
    paste0("BC2d < ", round(thresh_BC2d, 3), " > dog")
  )
)
  p_density <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% names(color_map)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Dog, fill=pop)) +
    geom_density(alpha=0.5, adjust=1) +
    geom_vline(data=thresholds_df, aes(xintercept=value),
               linetype="dashed", color="red", linewidth=0.6) +
    geom_text(data=thresholds_df, aes(x=value, y=45, label=label),
              inherit.aes=FALSE, angle=90, vjust=-0.4, size=3, color="red") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,50)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=color_map) +
    theme(legend.position="right", legend.title=element_blank()) +
    labs(title=paste("Distribution of dog Q-values"),
         subtitle="Dashed red lines show hybrid thresholds",
         x="Q_Dog value", y="Density (capped at 50)")

  ggsave(file.path(base_dir, paste0("R_results/1a_NDinaric_empirical_density_plot.png")),
         p_density, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

# ------------------------------------------
# PLOT 2: HEATMAP OF POP VS. HYBRID CLASS
# ------------------------------------------
table_data_plot <- table(structure_results_categories$pop,
                         structure_results_categories$hy_verdict)
categories_plot <- as.data.frame(table_data_plot)
names(categories_plot) <- c("pop","hy_verdict","count")

# fixed order for populations and hybrid classes


hy_levels <- c(
  "Dog", "BC2d","BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w",
 "Wolf"
)

# apply factor levels for consistent order across all seeds
categories_plot$pop <- factor(categories_plot$pop, levels = pop_levels)
categories_plot$hy_verdict <- factor(categories_plot$hy_verdict, levels = hy_levels)

p_heatmap <- ggplot(categories_plot, aes(x = pop, y = hy_verdict, fill = count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
  colours = c("white", "#deebf7", "#6baed6", "#2171b5"),
  values = scales::rescale(c(0, 3, max(categories_plot$count) * 0.5, max(categories_plot$count))))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title = paste("STRUCTURE assignment results vs. actual group"),
       x = "Actual group",
       y = "STRUCTURE assignment results")

ggsave(file.path(base_dir, paste0("R_results/1a_NDinaric_empirical_heatmap.png")),
       p_heatmap, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300)

}

```


Statistics - Hybrid classification accuracy
```{r}
# =====================================================
# SETTINGS
# =====================================================

seeds <- 1:1
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/1a_NDinaric_empirical"

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("N_Dinaric", "Dog")
)

pop_levels <- c(
  "Dog","Sim-Dog",
  "F1","BC1w","BC2w","W-Slovenia",
  "W-Croatia","Sim-W-Croatia"
)

wolf_classes <- c("W-Croatia","W-Slovenia")

expected_cols <- c(
  "Dog","BC2d","BC1d","F1","BC1w","BC2w","Wolf"
)

# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD AND CLASSIFY (SINGLE SEED)
# =====================================================

all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  cat("\n=== Seed", seed, "===\n")

  folder <- base_dir

  input_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("1a_NDinaric_empirical.txt"))
  pop_file   <- file.path(folder, paste0("1a_NDinaric_empirical_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  # --- load files
  struct_res    <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input  <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header = FALSE, sep = " ", as.is = TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:7])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(
    structure_results,
    struct_legend,
    by = c("Pop" = "id")
  )

  # =====================================================
  # THRESHOLDS
  # =====================================================

  thresholds_adj <- c(
    BC2d  = 0.94,
    BC1d  = 0.83,
    F1    = 0.64,
    BC1w   = 0.32,
    BC2w  = 0.12,
    Wolf  = 0.05
  )

  thresh_BC2d  <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d  <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_F1    <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_BC1w   <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_BC2w  <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_wolf  <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  # =====================================================
  # CLASSIFICATION
  # =====================================================

  structure_results_categories <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog, N_Dinaric), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE               ~ "Wolf"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(seed = seed) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, Dog, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- structure_results_categories
}

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ COMBINE (ONLY 1 SEED, BUT SAME STRUCTURE)
# =====================================================

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

performance_summary <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    classified_group = case_when(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes ~ "Wolf",
      TRUE ~ hy_verdict
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(pop) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(count),
    percentage = 100 * count / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = percentage,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Ensure all expected columns exist
missing_cols <- setdiff(expected_cols, names(performance_summary))
for (col in missing_cols) {
  performance_summary[[col]] <- 0
}

# Apply population order
performance_summary <- performance_summary %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ EXPORT (MATCHING YOUR MEAN SCRIPT STYLE)
# =====================================================

output_file <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "R_results/1a_Hybrid_classification_accuracy.xlsx"
)

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Classification_percentages")
writeData(wb, "Classification_percentages", performance_summary)

saveWorkbook(wb, output_file, overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
  thresh_BC1w   <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_BC2w  <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_wolf  <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  # =====================================================
  # CLASSIFICATION
  # =====================================================

  structure_results_categories <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog, N_Dinaric), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE               ~ "Wolf"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(seed = seed) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, Dog, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- structure_results_categories
}

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ COMBINE (ONLY 1 SEED, BUT SAME STRUCTURE)
# =====================================================

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

performance_summary <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    classified_group = case_when(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes ~ "Wolf",
      TRUE ~ hy_verdict
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(pop) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(count),
    percentage = 100 * count / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = percentage,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Ensure all expected columns exist
missing_cols <- setdiff(expected_cols, names(performance_summary))
for (col in missing_cols) {
  performance_summary[[col]] <- 0
}

# Apply population order
performance_summary <- performance_summary %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ EXPORT (MATCHING YOUR MEAN SCRIPT STYLE)
# =====================================================

output_file <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "R_results/1b_Hybrid_classification_accuracy.xlsx"
)

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Classification_percentages")
writeData(wb, "Classification_percentages", performance_summary)

saveWorkbook(wb, output_file, overwrite = TRUE)
```

Statistics - Hybrid classification accuracy
```{r}
# =====================================================
# SETTINGS
# =====================================================

seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog"

# Number of permutations / Monte Carlo replicates
B <- 9999
set.seed(123)

# Cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "2" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "3" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "4" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "5" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "6" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "7" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "8" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "9" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "10" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog")
)


pop_levels <- c(
  "Dog","Sim-dog",
  "F1", "BC1w","BC2w",
  "W-Slovenia", "W-Croatia"
)


wolf_classes <- c("N_Dinaric")

expected_cols <- c(
  "Dog","BC2d","BC1d","F1","BC1w","BC2w","Wolf"
)


# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD + CLASSIFY ALL SEEDS
# =====================================================

all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(
    base_dir,
    paste0("1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog_", seed)
  )

  input_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    paste0("1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog_", seed, ".txt")
  )

  pop_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    paste0("1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog_", seed, "_POP.txt")
  )

  clumpp_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output"
  )

  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)

  struct_input <- read.table(
    input_file,
    skip = 1,
    as.is = TRUE
  )

  struct_legend <- read.table(
    pop_file,
    header = FALSE,
    sep = " ",
    as.is = TRUE
  )

  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(
    struct_input[,1:2],
    struct_res[,6:7]
  )

  names(structure_results) <- c(
    "Sample",
    "Pop",
    cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]]
  )

  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(
    structure_results,
    struct_legend,
    by = c("Pop" = "id")
  )

  structure_results$pop <- factor(
    structure_results$pop,
    levels = pop_levels
  )


  # =====================================================
  # THRESHOLDS
  # =====================================================

  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_qDog = mean(as.numeric(Dog), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  thresholds_adj <- c(
    BC2d = 0.94,
    BC1d = 0.83,
    F1   = 0.64,
    BC1w = 0.32,
    BC2w = 0.12,
    Wolf = 0.05
  )

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_wolf <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]


  # =====================================================
  # CLASSIFICATION
  # =====================================================

  classified <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog, N_Dinaric), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE ~ "N_Dinaric"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- classified
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)


# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ CALCULATE HYBRID CLASSIFICATION ERROR METRICS
# =====================================================

accuracy_results[["1c_K2"]] <- make_error_metrics(
  all_classifications,
  "1c_NDinaric",
  2
)


# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ TEST CONSISTENCY OF ASSIGNMENTS ACROSS SEEDS
# =====================================================

classification_data <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    seed = as.character(seed),
    pop = as.character(pop),
    classified_group = ifelse(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes,
      "Wolf",
      as.character(hy_verdict)
    )
  )


# -----------------------------------------------------
# HELPER FUNCTION: PEARSON CHI-SQUARE STATISTIC
# -----------------------------------------------------

calculate_chisq <- function(tab) {

  expected <- outer(rowSums(tab), colSums(tab)) / sum(tab)

  sum((tab - expected)^2 / expected)
}


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3A. EMPIRICAL POPULATIONS
# Same individuals classified in all 10 seeds
# Within-individual permutation test
# -----------------------------------------------------

empirical_pops <- pop_levels[!grepl("^Sim-", pop_levels)]

empirical_tests <- lapply(empirical_pops, function(pop_name) {

  test_data <- classification_data %>%
    filter(
      pop == pop_name,
      !is.na(Sample)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      Sample,
      match(seed, as.character(seeds))
    ) %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    filter(
      n() == length(seeds),
      n_distinct(seed) == length(seeds)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(
      Sample,
      match(seed, as.character(seeds))
    )

  n_individuals <- n_distinct(test_data$Sample)


  # Not enough complete individuals
  if (n_individuals < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Empirical",
      n_units = n_individuals,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Within-individual permutation test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: fewer than two individuals"
    ))
  }


  valid_classes <- expected_cols[
    expected_cols %in% unique(test_data$classified_group)
  ]


  # One row per individual, one column per seed
  assignment_matrix <- matrix(
    test_data$classified_group,
    nrow = n_individuals,
    ncol = length(seeds),
    byrow = TRUE
  )


  # Construct observed table in the same order as the matrix:
  # all individuals from seed 1, then seed 2, etc.
  observed_table <- table(
    factor(
      rep(
        as.character(seeds),
        each = n_individuals
      ),
      levels = as.character(seeds)
    ),
    factor(
      as.vector(assignment_matrix),
      levels = valid_classes
    )
  )


  # If only one assignment category occurs, there is no
  # variation in assignments to test
  if (ncol(observed_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Empirical",
      n_units = n_individuals,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Within-individual permutation test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: only one assignment category"
    ))
  }


  observed_statistic <- calculate_chisq(observed_table)


  # Permute assignments among seeds within each individual
  null_statistics <- replicate(B, {

    permuted_matrix <- t(apply(
      assignment_matrix,
      1,
      function(x) sample(x, length(x))
    ))

    permuted_assignments <- as.vector(permuted_matrix)

    permuted_table <- table(
      factor(
        rep(
          as.character(seeds),
          each = n_individuals
        ),
        levels = as.character(seeds)
      ),
      factor(
        permuted_assignments,
        levels = valid_classes
      )
    )

    calculate_chisq(permuted_table)
  })


  p_value <- (
    1 + sum(null_statistics >= observed_statistic)
  ) / (B + 1)


  data.frame(
    pop = pop_name,
    sample_type = "Empirical",
    n_units = n_individuals,
    statistic = observed_statistic,
    df = NA_real_,
    p_value = p_value,
    test = "Within-individual permutation test",
    test_status = "Test performed"
  )
})

empirical_tests <- bind_rows(empirical_tests)


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3B. SIMULATED POPULATIONS
# Different simulated individuals in each seed
# Monte Carlo chi-square test of homogeneity
# -----------------------------------------------------

simulated_pops <- pop_levels[grepl("^Sim-", pop_levels)]

simulated_tests <- lapply(simulated_pops, function(pop_name) {

  test_data <- classification_data %>%
    filter(pop == pop_name)


  assignment_table <- table(
    factor(
      test_data$seed,
      levels = as.character(seeds)
    ),
    factor(
      test_data$classified_group,
      levels = expected_cols
    )
  )


  # Remove empty rows and columns
  assignment_table <- assignment_table[
    rowSums(assignment_table) > 0,
    colSums(assignment_table) > 0,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  n_observations <- sum(assignment_table)


  # Only one assignment category:
  # no variation to test
  if (ncol(assignment_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Simulated",
      n_units = n_observations,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: only one assignment category"
    ))
  }


  # Fewer than two seeds with observations
  if (nrow(assignment_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Simulated",
      n_units = n_observations,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: fewer than two seeds"
    ))
  }


  test_result <- chisq.test(
    assignment_table,
    simulate.p.value = TRUE,
    B = B
  )


  data.frame(
    pop = pop_name,
    sample_type = "Simulated",
    n_units = n_observations,
    statistic = unname(test_result$statistic),
    df = unname(test_result$parameter),
    p_value = test_result$p.value,
    test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
    test_status = "Test performed"
  )
})

simulated_tests <- bind_rows(simulated_tests)


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3C. COMBINE TESTS AND CORRECT FOR MULTIPLE TESTING
# -----------------------------------------------------

seed_tests <- bind_rows(
  empirical_tests,
  simulated_tests
) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "holm"
    ),
    significant = case_when(
      is.na(p_adjusted) ~ "Not tested",
      p_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(pop, pop_levels))


base::print(
  as.data.frame(seed_tests),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na.print = "NA"
)


# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ CALCULATE % PER SEED
# =====================================================

seed_counts <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels),
    classified_group = ifelse(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes,
      "Wolf",
      hy_verdict
    )
  ) %>%
  count(
    seed,
    pop,
    classified_group
  ) %>%
  complete(
    seed,
    pop = pop_levels,
    classified_group = expected_cols,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(seed, pop) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ PER-SEED TABLES
# =====================================================

seed_tables <- seed_counts %>%
  select(
    seed,
    pop,
    classified_group,
    percentage
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = percentage,
    values_fill = 0
  )


# =====================================================
# 6️⃣ MEAN + SD + SE + CI (FROM CODE 3)
# =====================================================

summary_stats <- seed_counts %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(percentage),
    sd = sd(percentage),
    n = n(),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = mean - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    ci_upper = mean + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# --- MEAN ONLY

mean_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(
    pop,
    classified_group,
    mean
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = mean,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(
    pop,
    all_of(expected_cols)
  )


# --- MEAN ± SD

mean_sd_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(
    pop,
    classified_group,
    mean,
    sd
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, sd)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {

  mean_sd_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f ± %.2f",
    mean_sd_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_sd_table[[paste0("sd_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_sd_table <- mean_sd_table %>%
  select(
    pop,
    all_of(expected_cols)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# --- MEAN ± SE

mean_se_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(
    pop,
    classified_group,
    mean,
    se
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, se)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {

  mean_se_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f ± %.2f",
    mean_se_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_se_table[[paste0("se_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_se_table <- mean_se_table %>%
  select(
    pop,
    all_of(expected_cols)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# --- MEAN ± CI

mean_ci_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(
    pop,
    classified_group,
    mean,
    ci_lower,
    ci_upper
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, ci_lower, ci_upper)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {

  mean_ci_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_lower_", cls)]],
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_upper_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_ci_table <- mean_ci_table %>%
  select(
    pop,
    all_of(expected_cols)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# =====================================================
# 7️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()


# --- Individual seed sheets

for (s in seeds) {

  seed_sheet <- seed_tables %>%
    filter(seed == s) %>%

      pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)

  )
}

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_CI")
```

Classification and Q_Dog value for empirical hybrids and problematic wolves
```{r}

# =====================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =====================================================
seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog"

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "2" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "3" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "4" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "5" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "6" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "7" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "8" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "9" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog"),
  "10" = c("N_Dinaric","Dog")
)
hybrid_labels <- c("BC2d","BC1d","F1","BC1w","BC2w")

# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD + CLASSIFY ALL SEEDS
# =====================================================
all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog_", seed))
  input_file  <- file.path(folder, paste0("1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file    <- file.path(folder, paste0("1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  struct_res    <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input  <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header = FALSE, as.is = TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:7])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend, by = c("Pop" = "id"))


  # ---- reference means (UNCHANGED)
  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% c("Dog","Sim-Dog",
                     "F1", "BC1w","BC2w", 
                      "W-Slovenia","W-Croatia")) %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(mean_qDog = mean(Dog, na.rm = TRUE), .groups="drop")

 thresholds_adj <- c(
  BC2d  = 0.94,
  BC1d  = 0.83,
  F1    = 0.64,
  BC1w   = 0.32,
  BC2w  = 0.12,
  Wolf  = 0.05)
  
  

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_wolf   <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  structure_results <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog, N_Dinaric), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
            hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE ~ "N_Dinaric"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, Dog, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- structure_results
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ FILTER: EMPIRICAL ONLY, NO DOGS
# =====================================================
all_classifications_empirical <- all_classifications %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("^Sim-", pop),   # remove simulated samples
    pop != "Dog"            # remove dogs
  )

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ SELECT ALL HYBRIDS + ONLY WOLVES EVER HYBRID
# =====================================================
samples_of_interest <- all_classifications_empirical %>%
  mutate(is_hybrid = hy_verdict %in% hybrid_labels) %>%
  group_by(Sample, pop) %>%
  summarise(ever_hybrid = any(is_hybrid), .groups="drop") %>%
  filter(!(pop %in% c("W-Slovenia","W-Croatia")) | ever_hybrid)

# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ PIVOT STRUCTURE assignment resultS (10 seeds)
# =====================================================
verdict_wide <- all_classifications_empirical %>%
  semi_join(samples_of_interest, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  select(Sample, pop, seed, hy_verdict) %>%
  mutate(seed = paste0("Seed", seed, "_class")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = hy_verdict)

# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ PIVOT Q_Dog valueS (10 seeds)
# =====================================================
qdog_wide <- all_classifications_empirical %>%
  semi_join(samples_of_interest, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  select(Sample, pop, seed, Dog) %>%
  mutate(seed = paste0("Seed", seed, "_qDog")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = Dog)

# =====================================================
# 6️⃣ FINAL 22-COLUMN TABLE
# =====================================================
final_hybrid_table <- verdict_wide %>%
  left_join(qdog_wide, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  rename(
    SampleID = Sample,
    Population = pop
  ) %>%
  arrange(Population, SampleID)

# =====================================================
# 6b️⃣ COUNT CLASSIFICATIONS ACROSS SEEDS (FIXED)
# =====================================================

# Identify class columns
class_cols <- grep("_class$", names(final_hybrid_table), value = TRUE)

# Convert to long format
class_long <- final_hybrid_table %>%
  select(SampleID, Population, all_of(class_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(class_cols),
    names_to = "Seed",
    values_to = "Class"
  )

# Count classifications per sample
class_counts <- class_long %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Population, Class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Pivot back to wide format
class_counts_wide <- class_counts %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Class,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0,
    names_prefix = "n_"
  )

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Combine all wolf-type assignments into one column
# -----------------------------------------------------

wolf_categories <- c(
  "W-Slovenia", "W-Croatia"
)

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Join back to main table
# -----------------------------------------------------

final_hybrid_table <- final_hybrid_table %>%
  left_join(class_counts_wide, by = c("SampleID","Population"))
# =====================================================
# 7️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================
write.xlsx(
  final_hybrid_table,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog/R_results/Empirical_hybrids_and_problematic_wolves_all_seeds_1c.xlsx",
  rowNames = FALSE
)
```

```{r}

seeds <- 1:10

  "9" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
```

```{r}
)


pop_levels <- c(
  "Dog",
  "Sim-BC2d_CRO","Sim-BC1d_CRO",
  "F1","Sim-F1_CRO",
  "BC1w","Sim-BC1w_CRO",
  "BC2w","Sim-BC2w_CRO",
  "W-Croatia"
)

# Classification categories that represent wolves
wolf_classes <- c("Wolf")

expected_cols <- c(
  "Dog","BC2d","BC1d","F1","BC1w","BC2w","Wolf"
)


# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD ALL SEEDS AND CLASSIFY
# =====================================================

all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(
    base_dir,

  )

  input_file <- file.path(

  )

  pop_file <- file.path(
    folder,

  )

  clumpp_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output"
  )

  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)

  struct_input <- read.table(
    input_file,
    skip = 1,
    as.is = TRUE
  )

  struct_legend <- read.table(
    pop_file,
    header = FALSE,
    sep = " ",
    as.is = TRUE
  )

  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(
    struct_input[,1:2],
    struct_res[,6:7]
  )

  names(structure_results) <- c(
    "Sample",
    "Pop",
    cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]]
  )

  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(
    structure_results,
    struct_legend,
    by = c("Pop" = "id")
  )

  structure_results$pop <- factor(
    structure_results$pop,
    levels = pop_levels
  )


  # =====================================================
  # THRESHOLDS (FROM CODE 2)
  # =====================================================

  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% pop_levels) %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_qDog = mean(as.numeric(Dog), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  mean_dog  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Dog", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_F1   <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-F1", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_wolf <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[ref_means$pop %in% c("W-Croatia")])

  thresh_BC2d <- (mean_dog + mean_BC2d) / 2
  thresh_BC1d <- (mean_BC2d + mean_BC1d) / 2
  thresh_F1   <- (mean_BC1d + mean_F1) / 2
  thresh_BC1w <- (mean_F1 + mean_BC1w) / 2
  thresh_BC2w <- (mean_BC1w + mean_BC2w) / 2
  thresh_wolf <- (mean_BC2w + mean_wolf) / 2

  thresholds_raw <- c(
    BC2d = thresh_BC2d,
    BC1d = thresh_BC1d,
    F1   = thresh_F1,
    BC1w = thresh_BC1w,
    BC2w = thresh_BC2w,
    Wolf = thresh_wolf
  )

  thresholds_adj <- thresholds_raw %>%
    pmax(c(0.9,0.8,0.6,0.3,0.1,0.05)) %>%
    round(3) %>%
    setNames(names(thresholds_raw))

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_wolf <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]


  # =====================================================
  # CLASSIFICATION
  # =====================================================

  classified <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog,Croatia), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE ~ "Wolf"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- classified
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)


# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ CALCULATE HYBRID CLASSIFICATION ERROR METRICS
# =====================================================

accuracy_results[["2ai_K2"]] <- make_error_metrics(
  all_classifications,
  "2ai_Croatia_low",
  2
)


# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ TEST CONSISTENCY OF ASSIGNMENTS ACROSS SEEDS
# =====================================================

classification_data <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    seed = as.character(seed),
    pop = as.character(pop),
    classified_group = ifelse(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes,
      "Wolf",
      as.character(hy_verdict)
    )
  )


# -----------------------------------------------------
# HELPER FUNCTION: PEARSON CHI-SQUARE STATISTIC
# -----------------------------------------------------

calculate_chisq <- function(tab) {

  expected <- outer(rowSums(tab), colSums(tab)) / sum(tab)

  sum((tab - expected)^2 / expected)
}


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3A. EMPIRICAL POPULATIONS
# Individuals may occur in different numbers of seeds
# Incomplete within-individual permutation test
# -----------------------------------------------------

empirical_pops <- pop_levels[!grepl("^Sim-", pop_levels)]

empirical_tests <- lapply(empirical_pops, function(pop_name) {

  # Retain individuals observed in at least two seeds.
  # Individuals appearing in only one seed cannot provide
  # a within-individual comparison across seeds.
  test_data <- classification_data %>%
    filter(
      pop == pop_name,
      !is.na(Sample)
    ) %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    filter(n_distinct(seed) >= 2) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(
      Sample,
      match(seed, as.character(seeds))
    )

  n_individuals <- n_distinct(test_data$Sample)


  # Not enough individuals observed in multiple seeds
  if (n_individuals < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Empirical",
      n_units = n_individuals,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Incomplete within-individual permutation test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: fewer than two individuals observed in multiple seeds"
    ))
  }


  valid_classes <- expected_cols[
    expected_cols %in% unique(test_data$classified_group)
  ]


  # Construct observed seed-by-assignment-category table
  observed_table <- table(
    factor(
      test_data$seed,
      levels = as.character(seeds)
    ),
    factor(
      test_data$classified_group,
      levels = valid_classes
    )
  )

  # Remove empty rows and columns
  observed_table <- observed_table[
    rowSums(observed_table) > 0,
    colSums(observed_table) > 0,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  # If only one assignment category occurs, there is no
  # variation in assignments to test
  if (ncol(observed_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Empirical",
      n_units = n_individuals,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Incomplete within-individual permutation test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: only one assignment category"
    ))
  }


  observed_statistic <- calculate_chisq(observed_table)


  # Permute assignments among the observed seed occurrences
  # of each individual. Each individual retains their own
  # number of observations and their observed seed occurrences.
  null_statistics <- replicate(B, {

    permuted_data <- test_data %>%
      group_by(Sample) %>%
      mutate(
        permuted_group = sample(
          classified_group,
          size = n(),
          replace = FALSE
        )
      ) %>%
      ungroup()

    permuted_table <- table(
      factor(
        permuted_data$seed,
        levels = as.character(seeds)
      ),
      factor(
        permuted_data$permuted_group,
        levels = valid_classes
      )
    )

    # Remove empty rows and columns
    permuted_table <- permuted_table[
      rowSums(permuted_table) > 0,
      colSums(permuted_table) > 0,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    calculate_chisq(permuted_table)
  })


  p_value <- (
    1 + sum(null_statistics >= observed_statistic)
  ) / (B + 1)


  data.frame(
    pop = pop_name,
    sample_type = "Empirical",
    n_units = n_individuals,
    statistic = observed_statistic,
    df = NA_real_,
    p_value = p_value,
    test = "Incomplete within-individual permutation test",
    test_status = "Test performed"
  )
})

empirical_tests <- bind_rows(empirical_tests)


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3B. SIMULATED POPULATIONS
# Different simulated individuals in each seed
# Monte Carlo chi-square test of homogeneity
# -----------------------------------------------------

simulated_pops <- pop_levels[grepl("^Sim-", pop_levels)]

simulated_tests <- lapply(simulated_pops, function(pop_name) {

  test_data <- classification_data %>%
    filter(pop == pop_name)

  assignment_table <- table(
    factor(
      test_data$seed,
      levels = as.character(seeds)
    ),
    factor(
      test_data$classified_group,
      levels = expected_cols
    )
  )

  # Remove empty rows and columns
  assignment_table <- assignment_table[
    rowSums(assignment_table) > 0,
    colSums(assignment_table) > 0,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  n_observations <- sum(assignment_table)


  # Only one assignment category:
  # no variation to test
  if (ncol(assignment_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Simulated",
      n_units = n_observations,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: only one assignment category"
    ))
  }


  # Fewer than two seeds with observations
  if (nrow(assignment_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Simulated",
      n_units = n_observations,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: fewer than two seeds"
    ))
  }


  test_result <- chisq.test(
    assignment_table,
    simulate.p.value = TRUE,
    B = B
  )


  data.frame(
    pop = pop_name,
    sample_type = "Simulated",
    n_units = n_observations,
    statistic = unname(test_result$statistic),
    df = unname(test_result$parameter),
    p_value = test_result$p.value,
    test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
    test_status = "Test performed"
  )
})

simulated_tests <- bind_rows(simulated_tests)


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3C. COMBINE TESTS AND CORRECT FOR MULTIPLE TESTING
# -----------------------------------------------------

seed_tests <- bind_rows(
  empirical_tests,
  simulated_tests
) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "holm"
    ),
    significant = case_when(
      is.na(p_adjusted) ~ "Not tested",
      p_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(pop, pop_levels))


base::print(
  as.data.frame(seed_tests),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na.print = "NA"
)


# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ CALCULATE % PER SEED
# =====================================================

seed_counts <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels),
    classified_group = ifelse(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes,
      "Wolf",
      hy_verdict
    )
  ) %>%
  count(
    seed,
    pop,
    classified_group
  ) %>%
  complete(
    seed,
    pop = pop_levels,
    classified_group = expected_cols,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(seed, pop) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ PER-SEED TABLES
# =====================================================

seed_tables <- seed_counts %>%
  select(
    seed,
    pop,
    classified_group,
    percentage
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = percentage,
    values_fill = 0
  )


# =====================================================
# 6️⃣ MEAN + SD + SE + CI
# =====================================================

summary_stats <- seed_counts %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(percentage),
    sd = sd(percentage),
    n = n(),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = mean - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    ci_upper = mean + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# --- MEAN ONLY

mean_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(
    pop,
    classified_group,
    mean
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = mean,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(
    pop,
    all_of(expected_cols)
  )


# --- MEAN ± SD

mean_sd_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(
    pop,
    classified_group,
    mean,
    sd
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, sd)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {

  mean_sd_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f ± %.2f",
    mean_sd_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_sd_table[[paste0("sd_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_sd_table <- mean_sd_table %>%
  select(
    pop,
    all_of(expected_cols)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# --- MEAN ± SE

mean_se_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(
    pop,
    classified_group,
    mean,
    se
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, se)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {

  mean_se_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f ± %.2f",
    mean_se_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_se_table[[paste0("se_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_se_table <- mean_se_table %>%
  select(
    pop,
    all_of(expected_cols)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# --- MEAN ± CI

mean_ci_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(
    pop,
    classified_group,
    mean,
    ci_lower,
    ci_upper
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, ci_lower, ci_upper)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {

  mean_ci_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_lower_", cls)]],
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_upper_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_ci_table <- mean_ci_table %>%
  select(
    pop,
    all_of(expected_cols)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# =====================================================
# 7️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()


# --- Individual seed sheets

for (s in seeds) {

  seed_sheet <- seed_tables %>%
    filter(seed == s) %>%
    mutate(
      pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)
    ) %>%
    arrange(pop) %>%
    select(
      pop,
      all_of(expected_cols)
    )

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0("Seed_", s))
  writeData(

}
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------
# CONFIGURATION
# ------------------------------------------
seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/2aii_Italy_low_numbers"

# Create R_results folder if it does not exist
dir.create(
  file.path(base_dir, "R_results"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "2" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "3" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "4" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "5" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "6" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "7" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "8" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "9" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "10" = c("Dog","Italy")
)

# colour palette for all plots


color_map <- c(
  "Dog"          = "#7f7f7f",

  # Dog backcrosses → hybrids (increasing saturation)
  "Sim-BC2d_ITA" = "#ffea00",
  "Sim-BC1d_ITA" = "#ff9f1c",
  "Sim-F1_ITA"   = "#e00000",
  "Sim-BC1w_ITA"  = "#6a040f",
  "Sim-BC2w_ITA" = "#3c096c",

  # Wolves
  "W-Italy"      = "#023047",
  "Sim-W-Italy"  = "#90dbf4"
)

pop_levels <- c(
"Dog",
"Sim-BC2d_ITA", "Sim-BC1d_ITA", "Sim-F1_ITA", "Sim-BC1w_ITA", "Sim-BC2w_ITA",
"W-Italy", "Sim-W-Italy"
)

# ------------------------------------------
# LOOP THROUGH SEEDS
# ------------------------------------------
for (seed in seeds) {
  cat("\n=== Seed", seed, "===\n")

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("2aii_Italy_low_numbers_", seed))
  input_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("2aii_Italy_low_numbers_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file   <- file.path(folder, paste0("2aii_Italy_low_numbers_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  # --- load data
  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input <- read.table(input_file, skip=1, as.is=TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header=FALSE, sep=" ", as.is=TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:7])
  structure_results$V2 <- as.character(structure_results$V2)
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend, by = c("Pop" = "id"))

  # ------------------------------------------------
  # FORCE POP ORDER FOR LEGEND 
  # ------------------------------------------------
 structure_results$pop <- factor(
    structure_results$pop,
    levels = pop_levels
  )

  # --- compute reference means and thresholds
  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% c("Dog",
                      "Sim-BC2d_ITA", "Sim-BC1d_ITA", "Sim-F1_ITA", "Sim-BC1w_ITA", "Sim-BC2w_ITA",
                      "W-Italy")) %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(mean_qDog = mean(Dog, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

  mean_dog  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Dog", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2d", ref_means$pop)])  
  mean_BC1d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1d", ref_means$pop)])
  
  mean_F1   <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-F1", ref_means$pop)])

  mean_BC1w  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_wolf <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[ref_means$pop %in% c("W-Italy")])

# Dog-side thresholds

thresh_BC2d <- (mean_dog  + mean_BC2d) / 2
thresh_BC1d <- (mean_BC2d + mean_BC1d) / 2
thresh_F1   <- (mean_BC1d + mean_F1)   / 2

# Wolf-side thresholds
thresh_BC1w <- (mean_F1   + mean_BC1w) / 2
thresh_BC2w <- (mean_BC1w + mean_BC2w) / 2
thresh_wolf <- (mean_BC2w + mean_wolf) / 2

  thresholds_raw <- c(
  BC2d  = thresh_BC2d,
  BC1d  = thresh_BC1d,
  F1    = thresh_F1,
  BC1w  = thresh_BC1w,
  BC2w  = thresh_BC2w,
  Wolf  = thresh_wolf)
  
  thresholds_adj <- thresholds_raw %>%
    pmax(c(
    0.9,  # BC2d minimum
    0.8,  # BC1d minimum
    0.6,  # F1 minimum 
    0.3,  # BC1w minimum
    0.1,  # BC2w minimum
    0.05   # Wolf cutoff 
    )) %>%
    round(3) %>%
    setNames(names(thresholds_raw))
  
  stopifnot(  #SANITY CHECK
  thresh_BC2d > thresh_BC1d,
  thresh_BC1d > thresh_F1,
  thresh_F1   > thresh_BC1w,
  thresh_BC1w > thresh_BC2w,
  thresh_BC2w > thresh_wolf
)

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_wolf   <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  # --- classify samples
structure_results_categories <- structure_results %>%
  mutate(across(c(Dog, Italy), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(
    hy_verdict = case_when(
      Dog >= thresh_BC2d        ~ "Dog",
      Dog >= thresh_BC1d        ~ "BC2d",
      Dog >= thresh_F1          ~ "BC1d",
      Dog >= thresh_BC1w        ~ "F1",
      Dog >= thresh_BC2w        ~ "BC1w",
      Dog >= thresh_wolf        ~ "BC2w",
      TRUE                      ~ "Wolf"
  ))

  # ------------------------------------------
  # PLOT 1: DENSITY PLOT
  # ------------------------------------------
  thresholds_df <- data.frame(
  value = c(
    thresh_wolf,
    thresh_BC2w,
    thresh_BC1w,
    thresh_F1,
    thresh_BC1d,
    thresh_BC2d
  ),
  label = c(
    paste0("wolf < ", round(thresh_wolf, 3), " > BC2w"),
    paste0("BC2w < ", round(thresh_BC2w, 3), " > BC1w"),
    paste0("BC1w < ", round(thresh_BC1w, 3), " > F1"),
    paste0("F1 < ", round(thresh_F1, 3), " > BC1d"),
    paste0("BC1d < ", round(thresh_BC1d, 3), " > BC2d"),
    paste0("BC2d < ", round(thresh_BC2d, 3), " > dog")
  )
)
  p_density <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% names(color_map)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Dog, fill=pop)) +
    geom_density(alpha=0.5, adjust=1) +
    geom_vline(data=thresholds_df, aes(xintercept=value),
               linetype="dashed", color="red", linewidth=0.6) +
    geom_text(data=thresholds_df, aes(x=value, y=45, label=label),
              inherit.aes=FALSE, angle=90, vjust=-0.4, size=3, color="red") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,50)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=color_map) +
    theme(legend.position="right", legend.title=element_blank()) +
    labs(title=paste("Distribution of dog Q-values – simulation replicate", seed),
         subtitle="Dashed red lines show hybrid thresholds",
         x="Q_Dog value", y="Density (capped at 50)")

  ggsave(file.path(paste0("ParallelStructure_Results/2aii_Italy_low_numbers/R_results/2aii_Italy_low_numbers_",seed,"_density_plot.png")),
         p_density, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

# ------------------------------------------
# PLOT 2: HEATMAP OF POP VS. HYBRID CLASS
# ------------------------------------------
table_data_plot <- table(structure_results_categories$pop,
                         structure_results_categories$hy_verdict)
categories_plot <- as.data.frame(table_data_plot)
names(categories_plot) <- c("pop","hy_verdict","count")

       x = "Actual group",

ggsave(file.path(paste0("ParallelStructure_Results/2aii_Italy_low_numbers/R_results/2aii_Italy_low_numbers_", seed, "_heatmap.png")),
       p_heatmap, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}
```

Statistics - Hybrid classification accuracy
```{r}
# =====================================================
# SETTINGS
# =====================================================

seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/2aii_Italy_low_numbers"

B <- 9999
set.seed(123)

cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "2" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "3" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "4" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "5" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "6" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "7" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "8" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "9" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "10" = c("Dog","Italy")
)

pop_levels <- c(
  "Dog",
  "Sim-BC2d_ITA", "Sim-BC1d_ITA", "Sim-F1_ITA",
  "Sim-BC1w_ITA", "Sim-BC2w_ITA",
  "W-Italy", "Sim-W-Italy"
)

wolf_classes <- c("Wolf")

expected_cols <- c(
  "Dog", "BC2d", "BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w", "Wolf"
)


# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD ALL SEEDS AND CLASSIFY
# =====================================================

all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(
    base_dir,
    paste0("2aii_Italy_low_numbers_", seed)
  )

  input_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    paste0("2aii_Italy_low_numbers_", seed, ".txt")
  )

  pop_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    paste0("2aii_Italy_low_numbers_", seed, "_POP.txt")
  )

  clumpp_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output"
  )

  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)

  struct_legend <- read.table(
    pop_file,
    header = FALSE,
    sep = " ",
    as.is = TRUE
  )

  names(struct_legend) <- c("id", "pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(
    struct_input[, 1:2],
    struct_res[, 6:7]
  )

  names(structure_results) <- c(
    "Sample", "Pop",
    cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]]
  )

  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(
    structure_results,
    struct_legend,
    by = c("Pop" = "id")
  )

  structure_results$pop <- factor(
    structure_results$pop,
    levels = pop_levels
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # THRESHOLDS
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% pop_levels) %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_qDog = mean(as.numeric(Dog), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  mean_dog  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Dog", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_F1   <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-F1", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_wolf <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[ref_means$pop %in% "W-Italy"])

  thresh_BC2d <- (mean_dog + mean_BC2d) / 2
  thresh_BC1d <- (mean_BC2d + mean_BC1d) / 2
  thresh_F1   <- (mean_BC1d + mean_F1) / 2
  thresh_BC1w <- (mean_F1 + mean_BC1w) / 2
  thresh_BC2w <- (mean_BC1w + mean_BC2w) / 2
  thresh_wolf <- (mean_BC2w + mean_wolf) / 2

  thresholds_raw <- c(
    BC2d = thresh_BC2d,
    BC1d = thresh_BC1d,
    F1 = thresh_F1,
    BC1w = thresh_BC1w,
    BC2w = thresh_BC2w,
    Wolf = thresh_wolf
  )

  thresholds_adj <- thresholds_raw %>%
    pmax(c(0.9, 0.8, 0.6, 0.3, 0.1, 0.05)) %>%
    round(3) %>%
    setNames(names(thresholds_raw))

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_wolf <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]


  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # CLASSIFICATION
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  classified <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog, Italy), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE ~ "Wolf"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- classified
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)


# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ CALCULATE HYBRID CLASSIFICATION ERROR METRICS
# =====================================================

accuracy_results[["2aii_K2"]] <- make_error_metrics(
  all_classifications,
  "2aii_Italy_low",
  2
)


# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ TEST CONSISTENCY OF ASSIGNMENTS ACROSS SEEDS
# =====================================================

classification_data <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    seed = as.character(seed),
    pop = as.character(pop),
    classified_group = ifelse(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes,
      "Wolf",
      as.character(hy_verdict)
    )
  )


# -----------------------------------------------------
# HELPER FUNCTION: PEARSON CHI-SQUARE STATISTIC
# -----------------------------------------------------

calculate_chisq <- function(tab) {

  expected <- outer(rowSums(tab), colSums(tab)) / sum(tab)

  sum((tab - expected)^2 / expected)
}


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3A. EMPIRICAL POPULATIONS
# Within-individual permutation test
# -----------------------------------------------------

empirical_pops <- pop_levels[!grepl("^Sim-", pop_levels)]

empirical_tests <- lapply(empirical_pops, function(pop_name) {

  test_data <- classification_data %>%
    filter(pop == pop_name, !is.na(Sample)) %>%
    arrange(Sample, match(seed, as.character(seeds))) %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    filter(
      n() == length(seeds),
      n_distinct(seed) == length(seeds)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Sample, match(seed, as.character(seeds)))

  n_individuals <- n_distinct(test_data$Sample)

  if (n_individuals < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Empirical",
      n_units = n_individuals,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Within-individual permutation test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: fewer than two individuals"
    ))
  }

  valid_classes <- expected_cols[
    expected_cols %in% unique(test_data$classified_group)
  ]

  assignment_matrix <- matrix(
    test_data$classified_group,
    nrow = n_individuals,
    ncol = length(seeds),
    byrow = TRUE
  )

  observed_table <- table(
    factor(
      rep(as.character(seeds), each = n_individuals),
      levels = as.character(seeds)
    ),
    factor(
      as.vector(assignment_matrix),
      levels = valid_classes
    )
  )

  if (ncol(observed_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Empirical",
      n_units = n_individuals,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Within-individual permutation test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: only one assignment category"
    ))
  }

  observed_statistic <- calculate_chisq(observed_table)

  null_statistics <- replicate(B, {

    permuted_matrix <- t(apply(
      assignment_matrix,
      1,
      function(x) sample(x, length(x))
    ))

    permuted_assignments <- as.vector(permuted_matrix)

    permuted_table <- table(
      factor(
        rep(as.character(seeds), each = n_individuals),
        levels = as.character(seeds)
      ),
      factor(
        permuted_assignments,
        levels = valid_classes
      )
    )

    calculate_chisq(permuted_table)
  })

  p_value <- (1 + sum(null_statistics >= observed_statistic)) / (B + 1)

  data.frame(
    pop = pop_name,
    sample_type = "Empirical",
    n_units = n_individuals,
    statistic = observed_statistic,
    df = NA_real_,
    p_value = p_value,
    test = "Within-individual permutation test",
    test_status = "Test performed"
  )
})

empirical_tests <- bind_rows(empirical_tests)


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3B. SIMULATED POPULATIONS
# Monte Carlo chi-square test of homogeneity
# -----------------------------------------------------

simulated_pops <- pop_levels[grepl("^Sim-", pop_levels)]

simulated_tests <- lapply(simulated_pops, function(pop_name) {

  test_data <- classification_data %>%
    filter(pop == pop_name)

  assignment_table <- table(
    factor(test_data$seed, levels = as.character(seeds)),
    factor(test_data$classified_group, levels = expected_cols)
  )

  assignment_table <- assignment_table[
    rowSums(assignment_table) > 0,
    colSums(assignment_table) > 0,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  n_observations <- sum(assignment_table)

  if (ncol(assignment_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Simulated",
      n_units = n_observations,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: only one assignment category"
    ))
  }

  if (nrow(assignment_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Simulated",
      n_units = n_observations,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: fewer than two seeds"
    ))
  }

  test_result <- chisq.test(
    assignment_table,
    simulate.p.value = TRUE,
    B = B
  )

  data.frame(
    pop = pop_name,
    sample_type = "Simulated",
    n_units = n_observations,
    statistic = unname(test_result$statistic),
    df = unname(test_result$parameter),
    p_value = test_result$p.value,
    test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
    test_status = "Test performed"
  )
})

simulated_tests <- bind_rows(simulated_tests)


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3C. COMBINE TESTS AND CORRECT FOR MULTIPLE TESTING
# -----------------------------------------------------

seed_tests <- bind_rows(
  empirical_tests,
  simulated_tests
) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm"),
    significant = case_when(
      is.na(p_adjusted) ~ "Not tested",
      p_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(pop, pop_levels))

base::print(
  as.data.frame(seed_tests),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na.print = "NA"
)


# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ CALCULATE % PER SEED
# =====================================================

seed_counts <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels),
    classified_group = ifelse(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes,
      "Wolf",
      hy_verdict
    )
  ) %>%
  count(seed, pop, classified_group) %>%
  complete(
    seed,
    pop = pop_levels,
    classified_group = expected_cols,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(seed, pop) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()


# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ PER-SEED TABLES
# =====================================================

seed_tables <- seed_counts %>%
  select(seed, pop, classified_group, percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = percentage,
    values_fill = 0
  )


# =====================================================
# 6️⃣ MEAN + SD + SE + CI
# =====================================================

summary_stats <- seed_counts %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(percentage),
    sd = sd(percentage),
    n = n(),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = mean - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    ci_upper = mean + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# --- MEAN ONLY

mean_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = mean,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))


# --- MEAN ± SD

mean_sd_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, sd) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, sd)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_sd_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f ± %.2f",
    mean_sd_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_sd_table[[paste0("sd_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_sd_table <- mean_sd_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# --- MEAN ± SE

mean_se_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, se) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, se)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_se_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f ± %.2f",
    mean_se_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_se_table[[paste0("se_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_se_table <- mean_se_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# --- MEAN ± CI

mean_ci_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, ci_lower, ci_upper) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, ci_lower, ci_upper)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_ci_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_lower_", cls)]],
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_upper_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_ci_table <- mean_ci_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# =====================================================
# 7️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()

for (s in seeds) {

  seed_sheet <- seed_tables %>%
    filter(seed == s) %>%
    mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
    arrange(pop) %>%
    select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0("Seed_", s))
  writeData(wb, paste0("Seed_", s), seed_sheet)
}

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_only")
writeData(wb, "Mean_only", mean_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SD")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SD", mean_sd_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SE")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SE", mean_se_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_CI")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_CI", mean_ci_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Seed_significance_tests")

# -----------------------------------------------------
# SAVE WORKBOOK
# -----------------------------------------------------

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/2aii_Italy_low_numbers/R_results/2aii_K2_Hybrid_classification_accuracy_seed_1-10-SD_SE_Cl.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
         subtitle="Dashed red lines show hybrid thresholds",
         x="Q_Dog value", y="Density (capped at 50)")

  ggsave(file.path(paste0("ParallelStructure_Results/2bi_Croatia_high_numbers/R_results/2bi_Croatia_high_numbers_",seed,"_density_plot.png")),
         p_density, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

# ------------------------------------------
# PLOT 2: HEATMAP OF POP VS. HYBRID CLASS
# ------------------------------------------
table_data_plot <- table(structure_results_categories$pop,
                         structure_results_categories$hy_verdict)
categories_plot <- as.data.frame(table_data_plot)
names(categories_plot) <- c("pop","hy_verdict","count")

# fixed order for populations and hybrid classes


hy_levels <- c(
  "Dog", "BC2d","BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w",
 "Wolf"
)

# apply factor levels for consistent order across all seeds

        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),

       x = "Actual group",

ggsave(file.path(paste0("ParallelStructure_Results/2bi_Croatia_high_numbers/R_results/2bi_Croatia_high_numbers_", seed, "_heatmap.png")),
       p_heatmap, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}
```
