Statistics - Hybrid classification accuracy

```{r}
# =====================================================
# SETTINGS
# =====================================================

seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/2bi_Croatia_high_numbers"

B <- 9999
set.seed(123)

cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "2" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "3" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "4" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "5" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "6" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "7" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "8" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "9" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "10" = c("Dog","Croatia")
)

pop_levels <- c(
  "Dog", "Sim-dog",
  "Sim-BC2d_CRO", "Sim-BC1d_CRO", "F1", "Sim-F1_CRO",
  "BC1w", "Sim-BC1w_CRO", "BC2w", "Sim-BC2w_CRO",
  "W-Croatia", "Sim-W-Croatia"
)

wolf_classes <- c("Wolf")

expected_cols <- c(
  "Dog", "BC2d", "BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w", "Wolf"
)


# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD ALL SEEDS AND CLASSIFY
# =====================================================

all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(
    base_dir,
    paste0("2bi_Croatia_high_numbers_", seed)
  )

  input_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    paste0("2bi_Croatia_high_numbers_", seed, ".txt")
  )

  pop_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    paste0("2bi_Croatia_high_numbers_", seed, "_POP.txt")
  )

  clumpp_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output"
  )

  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)

  struct_legend <- read.table(
    pop_file,
    header = FALSE,
    sep = " ",
    as.is = TRUE
  )

  names(struct_legend) <- c("id", "pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(
    struct_input[, 1:2],
    struct_res[, 6:7]
  )

  names(structure_results) <- c(
    "Sample", "Pop",
    cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]]
  )

  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(
    structure_results,
    struct_legend,
    by = c("Pop" = "id")
  )

  structure_results$pop <- factor(
    structure_results$pop,
    levels = pop_levels
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # THRESHOLDS
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% pop_levels) %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_qDog = mean(as.numeric(Dog), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  mean_dog  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Dog", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_F1   <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-F1", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_wolf <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[ref_means$pop %in% "W-Croatia"])

  thresh_BC2d <- (mean_dog + mean_BC2d) / 2
  thresh_BC1d <- (mean_BC2d + mean_BC1d) / 2
  thresh_F1   <- (mean_BC1d + mean_F1) / 2
  thresh_BC1w <- (mean_F1 + mean_BC1w) / 2
  thresh_BC2w <- (mean_BC1w + mean_BC2w) / 2
  thresh_wolf <- (mean_BC2w + mean_wolf) / 2

  thresholds_raw <- c(
    BC2d = thresh_BC2d,
    BC1d = thresh_BC1d,
    F1 = thresh_F1,
    BC1w = thresh_BC1w,
    BC2w = thresh_BC2w,
    Wolf = thresh_wolf
  )

  thresholds_adj <- thresholds_raw %>%
    pmax(c(0.9, 0.8, 0.6, 0.3, 0.1, 0.05)) %>%
    round(3) %>%
    setNames(names(thresholds_raw))

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_wolf <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]


  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # CLASSIFICATION
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  classified <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog, Croatia), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE ~ "Wolf"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- classified
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)


# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ CALCULATE HYBRID CLASSIFICATION ERROR METRICS
# =====================================================

accuracy_results[["2bi_K2"]] <- make_error_metrics(
  all_classifications,
  "2bi_Croatia_high",
  2
)


# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ TEST CONSISTENCY OF ASSIGNMENTS ACROSS SEEDS
# =====================================================

classification_data <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    seed = as.character(seed),
    pop = as.character(pop),
    classified_group = ifelse(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes,
      "Wolf",
      as.character(hy_verdict)
    )
  )


# -----------------------------------------------------
# HELPER FUNCTION: PEARSON CHI-SQUARE STATISTIC
# -----------------------------------------------------

calculate_chisq <- function(tab) {

  expected <- outer(rowSums(tab), colSums(tab)) / sum(tab)

  sum((tab - expected)^2 / expected)
}


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3A. EMPIRICAL POPULATIONS
# Within-individual permutation test
# -----------------------------------------------------

empirical_pops <- pop_levels[!grepl("^Sim-", pop_levels)]

empirical_tests <- lapply(empirical_pops, function(pop_name) {

  test_data <- classification_data %>%
    filter(pop == pop_name, !is.na(Sample)) %>%
    arrange(Sample, match(seed, as.character(seeds))) %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    filter(
      n() == length(seeds),
      n_distinct(seed) == length(seeds)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Sample, match(seed, as.character(seeds)))

  n_individuals <- n_distinct(test_data$Sample)

  if (n_individuals < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Empirical",
      n_units = n_individuals,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Within-individual permutation test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: fewer than two individuals"
    ))
  }

  valid_classes <- expected_cols[
    expected_cols %in% unique(test_data$classified_group)
  ]

  assignment_matrix <- matrix(
    test_data$classified_group,
    nrow = n_individuals,
    ncol = length(seeds),
    byrow = TRUE
  )

  observed_table <- table(
    factor(
      rep(as.character(seeds), each = n_individuals),
      levels = as.character(seeds)
    ),
    factor(
      as.vector(assignment_matrix),
      levels = valid_classes
    )
  )

  if (ncol(observed_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Empirical",
      n_units = n_individuals,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Within-individual permutation test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: only one assignment category"
    ))
  }

  observed_statistic <- calculate_chisq(observed_table)

  null_statistics <- replicate(B, {

    permuted_matrix <- t(apply(
      assignment_matrix,
      1,
      function(x) sample(x, length(x))
    ))

    permuted_assignments <- as.vector(permuted_matrix)

    permuted_table <- table(
      factor(
        rep(as.character(seeds), each = n_individuals),
        levels = as.character(seeds)
      ),
      factor(
        permuted_assignments,
        levels = valid_classes
      )
    )

    calculate_chisq(permuted_table)
  })

  p_value <- (1 + sum(null_statistics >= observed_statistic)) / (B + 1)

  data.frame(
    pop = pop_name,
    sample_type = "Empirical",
    n_units = n_individuals,
    statistic = observed_statistic,
    df = NA_real_,
    p_value = p_value,
    test = "Within-individual permutation test",
    test_status = "Test performed"
  )
})

empirical_tests <- bind_rows(empirical_tests)


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3B. SIMULATED POPULATIONS
# Monte Carlo chi-square test of homogeneity
# -----------------------------------------------------

simulated_pops <- pop_levels[grepl("^Sim-", pop_levels)]

simulated_tests <- lapply(simulated_pops, function(pop_name) {

  test_data <- classification_data %>%
    filter(pop == pop_name)

  assignment_table <- table(
    factor(test_data$seed, levels = as.character(seeds)),
    factor(test_data$classified_group, levels = expected_cols)
  )

  assignment_table <- assignment_table[
    rowSums(assignment_table) > 0,
    colSums(assignment_table) > 0,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  n_observations <- sum(assignment_table)

  if (ncol(assignment_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Simulated",
      n_units = n_observations,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: only one assignment category"
    ))
  }

  if (nrow(assignment_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Simulated",
      n_units = n_observations,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: fewer than two seeds"
    ))
  }

  test_result <- chisq.test(
    assignment_table,
    simulate.p.value = TRUE,
    B = B
  )

  data.frame(
    pop = pop_name,
    sample_type = "Simulated",
    n_units = n_observations,
    statistic = unname(test_result$statistic),
    df = unname(test_result$parameter),
    p_value = test_result$p.value,
    test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
    test_status = "Test performed"
  )
})

simulated_tests <- bind_rows(simulated_tests)


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3C. COMBINE TESTS AND CORRECT FOR MULTIPLE TESTING
# -----------------------------------------------------

seed_tests <- bind_rows(
  empirical_tests,
  simulated_tests
) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm"),
    significant = case_when(
      is.na(p_adjusted) ~ "Not tested",
      p_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(pop, pop_levels))

base::print(
  as.data.frame(seed_tests),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na.print = "NA"
)


# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ CALCULATE % PER SEED
# =====================================================

seed_counts <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels),
    classified_group = ifelse(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes,
      "Wolf",
      hy_verdict
    )
  ) %>%
  count(seed, pop, classified_group) %>%
  complete(
    seed,
    pop = pop_levels,
    classified_group = expected_cols,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(seed, pop) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()


# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ PER-SEED TABLES
# =====================================================

seed_tables <- seed_counts %>%
  select(seed, pop, classified_group, percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = percentage,
    values_fill = 0
  )


# =====================================================
# 6️⃣ MEAN + SD + SE + CI
# =====================================================

summary_stats <- seed_counts %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(percentage),
    sd = sd(percentage),
    n = n(),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = mean - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    ci_upper = mean + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# --- MEAN ONLY

mean_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = mean,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))


# --- MEAN ± SD

mean_sd_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, sd) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, sd)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_sd_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f ± %.2f",
    mean_sd_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_sd_table[[paste0("sd_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_sd_table <- mean_sd_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# --- MEAN ± SE

mean_se_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, se) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, se)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_se_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f ± %.2f",
    mean_se_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_se_table[[paste0("se_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_se_table <- mean_se_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# --- MEAN ± CI

mean_ci_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, ci_lower, ci_upper) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, ci_lower, ci_upper)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_ci_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_lower_", cls)]],
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_upper_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_ci_table <- mean_ci_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# =====================================================
# 7️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()

for (s in seeds) {

  seed_sheet <- seed_tables %>%
    filter(seed == s) %>%
    mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
    arrange(pop) %>%
    select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0("Seed_", s))
  writeData(wb, paste0("Seed_", s), seed_sheet)
}

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_only")
writeData(wb, "Mean_only", mean_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Seed_significance_tests")

# -----------------------------------------------------
# SAVE WORKBOOK
# -----------------------------------------------------

saveWorkbook(

  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

Classification and Q_Dog value for empirical hybrids and problematic wolves
```{r}

# =====================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =====================================================
seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/2bi_Croatia_high_numbers"

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog","Croatia"), "2" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "3" = c("Dog","Croatia"), "4" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "5" = c("Dog","Croatia"), "6" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "7" = c("Dog","Croatia"), "8" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "9" = c("Dog","Croatia"), "10" = c("Dog","Croatia")
)

hybrid_labels <- c("BC2d","BC1d","F1","BC1w","BC2w")

# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD + CLASSIFY ALL SEEDS
# =====================================================
all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("2bi_Croatia_high_numbers_", seed))
  input_file  <- file.path(folder, paste0("2bi_Croatia_high_numbers_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file    <- file.path(folder, paste0("2bi_Croatia_high_numbers_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  struct_res    <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input  <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header = FALSE, as.is = TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:7])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend, by = c("Pop" = "id"))


  # ---- reference means (UNCHANGED)
  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% c("Dog",
                      "Sim-BC2d_CRO","Sim-BC1d_CRO","Sim-F1_CRO",
                      "Sim-BC1w_CRO","Sim-BC2w_CRO",
                      "W-Croatia")) %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(mean_qDog = mean(Dog, na.rm = TRUE), .groups="drop")

  mean_dog   <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Dog", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2d  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1d  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_F1    <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-F1", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1w  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2w  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_wolf  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[ref_means$pop=="W-Croatia"])

  thresholds_raw <- c(
    BC2d = (mean_dog  + mean_BC2d) / 2,
    BC1d = (mean_BC2d + mean_BC1d) / 2,
    F1   = (mean_BC1d + mean_F1) / 2,
    BC1w = (mean_F1   + mean_BC1w) / 2,
    BC2w = (mean_BC1w + mean_BC2w) / 2,
    Wolf = (mean_BC2w + mean_wolf) / 2
  )

  thresholds <- thresholds_raw %>%
    pmax(c(0.9, 0.8, 0.6, 0.3, 0.1, 0.05)) %>%
    round(3) %>%
    setNames(names(thresholds_raw))

  structure_results <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog, Croatia), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresholds["BC2d"] ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresholds["BC1d"] ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresholds["F1"]   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresholds["BC1w"]  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresholds["BC2w"] ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresholds["Wolf"] ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE                      ~ "Wolf"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, Dog, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- structure_results
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ FILTER: EMPIRICAL ONLY, NO DOGS
# =====================================================
all_classifications_empirical <- all_classifications %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("^Sim-", pop),   # remove simulated samples
    pop != "Dog"            # remove dogs
  )

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ SELECT ALL HYBRIDS + ONLY WOLVES EVER HYBRID
# =====================================================
samples_of_interest <- all_classifications_empirical %>%
  mutate(is_hybrid = hy_verdict %in% hybrid_labels) %>%
  group_by(Sample, pop) %>%
  summarise(ever_hybrid = any(is_hybrid), .groups="drop") %>%
  filter(pop != "W-Croatia" | ever_hybrid)

# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ PIVOT STRUCTURE Assignment Results (10 seeds)
# =====================================================
verdict_wide <- all_classifications_empirical %>%
  semi_join(samples_of_interest, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  select(Sample, pop, seed, hy_verdict) %>%
  mutate(seed = paste0("Seed", seed, "_class")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = hy_verdict)

# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ PIVOT Q_Dog valueS (10 seeds)
# =====================================================
qdog_wide <- all_classifications_empirical %>%
  semi_join(samples_of_interest, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  select(Sample, pop, seed, Dog) %>%
  mutate(seed = paste0("Seed", seed, "_qDog")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = Dog)

# =====================================================
# 6️⃣ FINAL 22-COLUMN TABLE
# =====================================================
final_hybrid_table <- verdict_wide %>%
  left_join(qdog_wide, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  rename(
    SampleID = Sample,
    Population = pop
  ) %>%
  arrange(Population, SampleID)

# =====================================================
# 6b️⃣ COUNT CLASSIFICATIONS ACROSS SEEDS (FIXED)
# =====================================================

# Identify class columns
class_cols <- grep("_class$", names(final_hybrid_table), value = TRUE)

# Convert to long format
class_long <- final_hybrid_table %>%
  select(SampleID, Population, all_of(class_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(class_cols),
    names_to = "Seed",
    values_to = "Class"
  )

# Count classifications per sample
class_counts <- class_long %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Population, Class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Pivot back to wide format
class_counts_wide <- class_counts %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Class,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0,
    names_prefix = "n_"
  )

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Combine all wolf-type assignments into one column
# -----------------------------------------------------

wolf_categories <- c(
  "W-Croatia"
)

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Join back to main table
# -----------------------------------------------------

final_hybrid_table <- final_hybrid_table %>%
  left_join(class_counts_wide, by = c("SampleID","Population"))
# =====================================================
# 7️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================
write.xlsx(
  final_hybrid_table,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/2bi_Croatia_high_numbers/R_results/2bi_Empirical_hybrids_and_problematic_wolves_all_seeds.xlsx",
  rowNames = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
 structure_results$pop <- factor(

  p_density <- structure_results %>%
```

Statistics - Hybrid classification accuracy

```{r}
# =====================================================
# SETTINGS
# =====================================================

seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/2bii_Italy_high_numbers"

B <- 9999
set.seed(123)

cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "2" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "3" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "4" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "5" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "6" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "7" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "8" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "9" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "10" = c("Dog","Italy")
)

pop_levels <- c(
  "Dog", "Sim-dog",
  "Sim-BC2d_ITA", "Sim-BC1d_ITA", "Sim-F1_ITA",
  "Sim-BC1w_ITA", "Sim-BC2w_ITA",
  "W-Italy", "Sim-W-Italy"
)

wolf_classes <- c("Wolf")

expected_cols <- c(
  "Dog", "BC2d", "BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w", "Wolf"
)


# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD ALL SEEDS AND CLASSIFY
# =====================================================

all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(
    base_dir,
    paste0("2bii_Italy_high_numbers_", seed)
  )

  input_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    paste0("2bii_Italy_high_numbers_", seed, ".txt")
  )

  pop_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    paste0("2bii_Italy_high_numbers_", seed, "_POP.txt")
  )

  clumpp_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output"
  )

  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)

  struct_legend <- read.table(
    pop_file,
    header = FALSE,
    sep = " ",
    as.is = TRUE
  )

  names(struct_legend) <- c("id", "pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(
    struct_input[, 1:2],
    struct_res[, 6:7]
  )

  names(structure_results) <- c(
    "Sample", "Pop",
    cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]]
  )

  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(
    structure_results,
    struct_legend,
    by = c("Pop" = "id")
  )

  structure_results$pop <- factor(
    structure_results$pop,
    levels = pop_levels
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # THRESHOLDS
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% pop_levels) %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_qDog = mean(as.numeric(Dog), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  mean_dog  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Dog", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_F1   <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-F1", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_wolf <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[ref_means$pop %in% "W-Italy"])

  thresh_BC2d <- (mean_dog + mean_BC2d) / 2
  thresh_BC1d <- (mean_BC2d + mean_BC1d) / 2
  thresh_F1   <- (mean_BC1d + mean_F1) / 2
  thresh_BC1w <- (mean_F1 + mean_BC1w) / 2
  thresh_BC2w <- (mean_BC1w + mean_BC2w) / 2
  thresh_wolf <- (mean_BC2w + mean_wolf) / 2

  thresholds_raw <- c(
    BC2d = thresh_BC2d,
    BC1d = thresh_BC1d,
    F1 = thresh_F1,
    BC1w = thresh_BC1w,
    BC2w = thresh_BC2w,
    Wolf = thresh_wolf
  )

  thresholds_adj <- thresholds_raw %>%
    pmax(c(0.9, 0.8, 0.6, 0.3, 0.1, 0.05)) %>%
    round(3) %>%
    setNames(names(thresholds_raw))

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_wolf <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]


  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # CLASSIFICATION
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  classified <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog, Italy), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE ~ "Wolf"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- classified
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)


# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ CALCULATE HYBRID CLASSIFICATION ERROR METRICS
# =====================================================

accuracy_results[["2bii_K2"]] <- make_error_metrics(
  all_classifications,
  "2bii_Italy_high",
  2
)


# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ TEST CONSISTENCY OF ASSIGNMENTS ACROSS SEEDS
# =====================================================

classification_data <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    seed = as.character(seed),
    pop = as.character(pop),
    classified_group = ifelse(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes,
      "Wolf",
      as.character(hy_verdict)
    )
  )


# -----------------------------------------------------
# HELPER FUNCTION: PEARSON CHI-SQUARE STATISTIC
# -----------------------------------------------------

calculate_chisq <- function(tab) {

  expected <- outer(rowSums(tab), colSums(tab)) / sum(tab)

  sum((tab - expected)^2 / expected)
}


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3A. EMPIRICAL POPULATIONS
# Within-individual permutation test
# -----------------------------------------------------

empirical_pops <- pop_levels[!grepl("^Sim-", pop_levels)]

empirical_tests <- lapply(empirical_pops, function(pop_name) {

  test_data <- classification_data %>%
    filter(pop == pop_name, !is.na(Sample)) %>%
    arrange(Sample, match(seed, as.character(seeds))) %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    filter(
      n() == length(seeds),
      n_distinct(seed) == length(seeds)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Sample, match(seed, as.character(seeds)))

  n_individuals <- n_distinct(test_data$Sample)

  if (n_individuals < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Empirical",
      n_units = n_individuals,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Within-individual permutation test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: fewer than two individuals"
    ))
  }

  valid_classes <- expected_cols[
    expected_cols %in% unique(test_data$classified_group)
  ]

  assignment_matrix <- matrix(
    test_data$classified_group,
    nrow = n_individuals,
    ncol = length(seeds),
    byrow = TRUE
  )

  observed_table <- table(
    factor(
      rep(as.character(seeds), each = n_individuals),
      levels = as.character(seeds)
    ),
    factor(
      as.vector(assignment_matrix),
      levels = valid_classes
    )
  )

  if (ncol(observed_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Empirical",
      n_units = n_individuals,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Within-individual permutation test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: only one assignment category"
    ))
  }

  observed_statistic <- calculate_chisq(observed_table)

  null_statistics <- replicate(B, {

    permuted_matrix <- t(apply(
      assignment_matrix,
      1,
      function(x) sample(x, length(x))
    ))

    permuted_assignments <- as.vector(permuted_matrix)

    permuted_table <- table(
      factor(
        rep(as.character(seeds), each = n_individuals),
        levels = as.character(seeds)
      ),
      factor(
        permuted_assignments,
        levels = valid_classes
      )
    )

    calculate_chisq(permuted_table)
  })

  p_value <- (1 + sum(null_statistics >= observed_statistic)) / (B + 1)

  data.frame(
    pop = pop_name,
    sample_type = "Empirical",
    n_units = n_individuals,
    statistic = observed_statistic,
    df = NA_real_,
    p_value = p_value,
    test = "Within-individual permutation test",
    test_status = "Test performed"
  )
})

empirical_tests <- bind_rows(empirical_tests)


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3B. SIMULATED POPULATIONS
# Monte Carlo chi-square test of homogeneity
# -----------------------------------------------------

simulated_pops <- pop_levels[grepl("^Sim-", pop_levels)]

simulated_tests <- lapply(simulated_pops, function(pop_name) {

  test_data <- classification_data %>%
    filter(pop == pop_name)

  assignment_table <- table(
    factor(test_data$seed, levels = as.character(seeds)),
    factor(test_data$classified_group, levels = expected_cols)
  )

  assignment_table <- assignment_table[
    rowSums(assignment_table) > 0,
    colSums(assignment_table) > 0,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  n_observations <- sum(assignment_table)

  if (ncol(assignment_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Simulated",
      n_units = n_observations,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: only one assignment category"
    ))
  }

  if (nrow(assignment_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Simulated",
      n_units = n_observations,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: fewer than two seeds"
    ))
  }

  test_result <- chisq.test(
    assignment_table,
    simulate.p.value = TRUE,
    B = B
  )

  data.frame(
    pop = pop_name,
    sample_type = "Simulated",
    n_units = n_observations,
    statistic = unname(test_result$statistic),
    df = unname(test_result$parameter),
    p_value = test_result$p.value,
    test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
    test_status = "Test performed"
  )
})

simulated_tests <- bind_rows(simulated_tests)


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3C. COMBINE TESTS AND CORRECT FOR MULTIPLE TESTING
# -----------------------------------------------------

seed_tests <- bind_rows(
  empirical_tests,
  simulated_tests
) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm"),
    significant = case_when(
      is.na(p_adjusted) ~ "Not tested",
      p_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(pop, pop_levels))

base::print(
  as.data.frame(seed_tests),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na.print = "NA"
)


# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ CALCULATE % PER SEED
# =====================================================

seed_counts <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels),
    classified_group = ifelse(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes,
      "Wolf",
      hy_verdict
    )
  ) %>%
  count(seed, pop, classified_group) %>%
  complete(
    seed,
    pop = pop_levels,
    classified_group = expected_cols,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(seed, pop) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()


# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ PER-SEED TABLES
# =====================================================

seed_tables <- seed_counts %>%
  select(seed, pop, classified_group, percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = percentage,
    values_fill = 0
  )


# =====================================================
# 6️⃣ MEAN + SD + SE + CI
# =====================================================

summary_stats <- seed_counts %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(percentage),
    sd = sd(percentage),
    n = n(),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = mean - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    ci_upper = mean + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# --- MEAN ONLY

mean_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = mean,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))


# --- MEAN ± SD

mean_sd_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, sd) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, sd)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_sd_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f ± %.2f",
    mean_sd_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_sd_table[[paste0("sd_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_sd_table <- mean_sd_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# --- MEAN ± SE

mean_se_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, se) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, se)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_se_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f ± %.2f",
    mean_se_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_se_table[[paste0("se_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_se_table <- mean_se_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# --- MEAN ± CI

mean_ci_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, ci_lower, ci_upper) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, ci_lower, ci_upper)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_ci_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_lower_", cls)]],
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_upper_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_ci_table <- mean_ci_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# =====================================================
# 7️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()

for (s in seeds) {

  seed_sheet <- seed_tables %>%
    filter(seed == s) %>%
    mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
    arrange(pop) %>%
    select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0("Seed_", s))
  writeData(wb, paste0("Seed_", s), seed_sheet)
}

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_only")
writeData(wb, "Mean_only", mean_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SD")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SD", mean_sd_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SE")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SE", mean_se_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_CI")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_CI", mean_ci_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Seed_significance_tests")
writeData(wb, "Seed_significance_tests", seed_tests)


# -----------------------------------------------------
# SAVE WORKBOOK
# -----------------------------------------------------

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/2bii_Italy_high_numbers/R_results/2bii_K2_Hybrid_classification_accuracy_seed_1-10-SD_SE_Cl.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```




2.3 All empirical samples with reference populations

3a) Empirical individuals only: Without balancing the populations STRUCTURE and CLUMPAK results were not good, so we did not analyse the data further.

3b) Empirical individuals and simulated reference samples to balance groups sizes

Statistics - Hybrid classification accuracy (K=6)
```{r}
# =====================================================
# SETTINGS
# =====================================================

seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids"

# Number of permutations / Monte Carlo replicates
B <- 9999
set.seed(123)

# Cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("S_Balkan", "Dog", "Italy", "Germany", "Romania", "N_Dinaric"),
  "2" = c("N_Dinaric", "Italy", "Germany", "Dog", "Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "3" = c("Germany", "N_Dinaric", "Dog", "Italy", "Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "4" = c("Germany", "N_Dinaric", "Dog", "Italy", "Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "5" = c("N_Dinaric", "Germany", "Italy", "Dog", "Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "6" = c("N_Dinaric", "Germany", "Italy", "Dog", "Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "7" = c("S_Balkan", "Germany", "Dog", "Italy", "Romania", "N_Dinaric"),
  "8" = c("N_Dinaric", "Dog", "Italy", "Germany", "Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "9" = c("N_Dinaric", "Italy", "Germany", "Dog", "Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "10" = c("N_Dinaric", "Germany", "Italy", "Dog", "Romania", "S_Balkan")
)

pop_levels <- c(
  "Dog", "Sim-dog",
  "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w",
  "W-Slovenia", "W-Croatia",
  "W-Middle_Balkan",
  "W-N.Macedonia", "Sim-W-N.Macedonia",
  "W-Bulgaria", "Sim-W-Bulgaria",
  "W-Italy", "Sim-W-Italy",
  "W-Germany", "Sim-W-Germany",
  "W-Romania", "Sim-W-Romania"
)

wolf_classes <- c(
  "N_Dinaric", "S_Balkan", "Italian",
  "German", "Romanian", "Mixed"
)

expected_cols <- c(
  "Dog", "BC2d", "BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w", "Wolf"
)


# =====================================================
# 1. LOAD + CLASSIFY ALL SEEDS
# =====================================================

all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(
    base_dir,
    paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed)
  )

  input_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed, ".txt")
  )

  pop_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed, "_POP.txt")
  )

  clumpp_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    "Clumpak_results/K=6/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output"
  )

  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(
    pop_file,
    header = FALSE,
    sep = " ",
    as.is = TRUE
  )

  names(struct_legend) <- c("id", "pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(
    struct_input[, 1:2],
    struct_res[, 6:11]
  )

  names(structure_results) <- c(
    "Sample", "Pop",
    cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]]
  )

  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(
    structure_results,
    struct_legend,
    by = c("Pop" = "id")
  )

  structure_results$pop <- factor(
    structure_results$pop,
    levels = pop_levels
  )


  # -----------------------------------------------------
  # THRESHOLDS
  # -----------------------------------------------------

  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_qDog = mean(as.numeric(Dog), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  thresholds_adj <- c(
    BC2d = 0.94,
    BC1d = 0.83,
    F1 = 0.64,
    BC1w = 0.32,
    BC2w = 0.12,
    Wolf = 0.05
  )

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_F1 <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_wolf <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]


  # -----------------------------------------------------
  # CLASSIFICATION
  # -----------------------------------------------------

  classified <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        c(Dog, N_Dinaric, S_Balkan, Italy, Germany, Romania),
        as.numeric
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1 ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        N_Dinaric > 0.8 ~ "N_Dinaric",
        S_Balkan > 0.8 ~ "S_Balkan",
        Italy > 0.8 ~ "Italian",
        Germany > 0.8 ~ "German",
        Romania > 0.8 ~ "Romanian",
        TRUE ~ "Mixed"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- classified
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)


# =====================================================
# 2. CALCULATE HYBRID CLASSIFICATION ERROR METRICS
# =====================================================

accuracy_results[["3b_K6"]] <- make_error_metrics(
  all_classifications,
  "3b_empirical_simulation",
  6
)


# =====================================================
# 3️. TEST CONSISTENCY OF ASSIGNMENTS ACROSS SEEDS
# =====================================================

classification_data <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    seed = as.character(seed),
    pop = as.character(pop),
    classified_group = ifelse(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes,
      "Wolf",
      as.character(hy_verdict)
    )
  )


# -----------------------------------------------------
# HELPER FUNCTION: PEARSON CHI-SQUARE STATISTIC
# -----------------------------------------------------

calculate_chisq <- function(tab) {

  expected <- outer(rowSums(tab), colSums(tab)) / sum(tab)

  sum((tab - expected)^2 / expected)
}


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3A. EMPIRICAL POPULATIONS
# Same individuals classified in all 10 seeds
# Within-individual permutation test
# -----------------------------------------------------

empirical_pops <- pop_levels[!grepl("^Sim-", pop_levels)]

empirical_tests <- lapply(empirical_pops, function(pop_name) {

  test_data <- classification_data %>%
    filter(pop == pop_name, !is.na(Sample)) %>%
    arrange(Sample, match(seed, as.character(seeds))) %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    filter(
      n() == length(seeds),
      n_distinct(seed) == length(seeds)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Sample, match(seed, as.character(seeds)))

  n_individuals <- n_distinct(test_data$Sample)

  # Not enough complete individuals
  if (n_individuals < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Empirical",
      n_units = n_individuals,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Within-individual permutation test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: fewer than two individuals"
    ))
  }

  valid_classes <- expected_cols[
    expected_cols %in% unique(test_data$classified_group)
  ]

  # One row per individual, one column per seed
  assignment_matrix <- matrix(
    test_data$classified_group,
    nrow = n_individuals,
    ncol = length(seeds),
    byrow = TRUE
  )

  # Construct observed table in the same order as the matrix:
  # all individuals from seed 1, then seed 2, etc.
  observed_table <- table(
    factor(
      rep(as.character(seeds), each = n_individuals),
      levels = as.character(seeds)
    ),
    factor(
      as.vector(assignment_matrix),
      levels = valid_classes
    )
  )

  # If only one assignment category occurs, there is no
  # variation in assignments to test
if (ncol(observed_table) < 2) {

  return(data.frame(
    pop = pop_name,
    sample_type = "Empirical",
    n_units = n_individuals,
    statistic = NA_real_,
    df = NA_real_,
    p_value = NA_real_,
    test = "Within-individual permutation test",
    test_status = "Not applicable: only one assignment category"
  ))
}

  observed_statistic <- calculate_chisq(observed_table)

  # Permute assignments among seeds within each individual
  null_statistics <- replicate(B, {

    permuted_matrix <- t(apply(
      assignment_matrix,
      1,
      function(x) sample(x, length(x))
    ))

    permuted_assignments <- as.vector(permuted_matrix)

    permuted_table <- table(
      factor(
        rep(as.character(seeds), each = n_individuals),
        levels = as.character(seeds)
      ),
      factor(
        permuted_assignments,
        levels = valid_classes
      )
    )

    calculate_chisq(permuted_table)
  })

  p_value <- (1 + sum(null_statistics >= observed_statistic)) / (B + 1)

  data.frame(
    pop = pop_name,
    sample_type = "Empirical",
    n_units = n_individuals,
    statistic = observed_statistic,
    df = NA_real_,
    p_value = p_value,
    test = "Within-individual permutation test",
    test_status = "Test performed"
  )
})

empirical_tests <- bind_rows(empirical_tests)


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3B. SIMULATED POPULATIONS
# Different simulated individuals in each seed
# Monte Carlo chi-square test of homogeneity
# -----------------------------------------------------

simulated_pops <- pop_levels[grepl("^Sim-", pop_levels)]

simulated_tests <- lapply(simulated_pops, function(pop_name) {

  test_data <- classification_data %>%
    filter(pop == pop_name)

  assignment_table <- table(
    factor(test_data$seed, levels = as.character(seeds)),
    factor(test_data$classified_group, levels = expected_cols)
  )

  # Remove empty rows and columns
  assignment_table <- assignment_table[
    rowSums(assignment_table) > 0,
    colSums(assignment_table) > 0,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  n_observations <- sum(assignment_table)

  # Only one assignment category:
  # no variation to test
  if (ncol(assignment_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Simulated",
      n_units = n_observations,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: only one assignment category"
    ))
  }

  # Fewer than two seeds with observations
  if (nrow(assignment_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Simulated",
      n_units = n_observations,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: fewer than two seeds"
    ))
  }

  test_result <- chisq.test(
    assignment_table,
    simulate.p.value = TRUE,
    B = B
  )

  data.frame(
    pop = pop_name,
    sample_type = "Simulated",
    n_units = n_observations,
    statistic = unname(test_result$statistic),
    df = unname(test_result$parameter),
    p_value = test_result$p.value,
    test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
    test_status = "Test performed"
  )
})

simulated_tests <- bind_rows(simulated_tests)


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3C. COMBINE TESTS AND CORRECT FOR MULTIPLE TESTING
# -----------------------------------------------------

seed_tests <- bind_rows(
  empirical_tests,
  simulated_tests
) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm"),
    significant = case_when(
      is.na(p_adjusted) ~ "Not tested",
      p_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(pop, pop_levels))

base::print(
  as.data.frame(seed_tests),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na.print = "NA"
)

# =====================================================
# 4. CALCULATE % PER SEED
# =====================================================

seed_counts <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels),
    classified_group = ifelse(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes,
      "Wolf",
      hy_verdict
    )
  ) %>%
  count(seed, pop, classified_group) %>%
  complete(
    seed,
    pop = pop_levels,
    classified_group = expected_cols,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(seed, pop) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()


# =====================================================
# 5. PER-SEED TABLES
# =====================================================

seed_tables <- seed_counts %>%
  select(seed, pop, classified_group, percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = percentage,
    values_fill = 0
  )


# =====================================================
# 6. MEAN + SD + SE + CI
# =====================================================

summary_stats <- seed_counts %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(percentage),
    sd = sd(percentage),
    n = n(),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = mean - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    ci_upper = mean + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# --- MEAN ONLY

mean_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = mean,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))


# --- MEAN ± SD

mean_sd_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, sd) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, sd)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_sd_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f ± %.2f",
    mean_sd_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_sd_table[[paste0("sd_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_sd_table <- mean_sd_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# --- MEAN ± SE

mean_se_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, se) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, se)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_se_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f ± %.2f",
    mean_se_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_se_table[[paste0("se_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_se_table <- mean_se_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# --- MEAN ± CI

mean_ci_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, ci_lower, ci_upper) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, ci_lower, ci_upper)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_ci_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_lower_", cls)]],
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_upper_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_ci_table <- mean_ci_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# =====================================================
# 7. EXPORT
# =====================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()

# --- Individual seed sheets

for (s in seeds) {

  seed_sheet <- seed_tables %>%
    filter(seed == s) %>%
    mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
    arrange(pop) %>%
    select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0("Seed_", s))
  writeData(wb, paste0("Seed_", s), seed_sheet)
}


# --- Summary sheets

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_only")
writeData(wb, "Mean_only", mean_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SD")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SD", mean_sd_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SE")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SE", mean_se_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_CI")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_CI", mean_ci_table)


# --- Seed consistency tests

addWorksheet(wb, "Seed_significance_tests")
writeData(wb, "Seed_significance_tests", seed_tests)


# --- Save workbook

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids/R_results/3b_K6_Hybrid_classification_accuracy_per_seed_1-10_SD_SE_CI.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

Classification and Q_Dog value for empirical hybrids and problematic wolves (K=6)
```{r}
# =====================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =====================================================
seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids"

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("S_Balkan",  "Dog", "Italy", "Germany","Romania", "N_Dinaric"),
  "2" = c("N_Dinaric",  "Italy", "Germany", "Dog","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "3" = c("Germany",  "N_Dinaric", "Dog", "Italy","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "4" = c("Germany",  "N_Dinaric", "Dog", "Italy","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "5" = c("N_Dinaric",  "Germany", "Italy", "Dog","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "6" = c("N_Dinaric",  "Germany", "Italy", "Dog","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "7" = c("S_Balkan",  "Germany", "Dog", "Italy","Romania", "N_Dinaric"),
  "8" = c("N_Dinaric",  "Dog", "Italy", "Germany","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "9" = c("N_Dinaric",  "Italy", "Germany", "Dog","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "10" = c("N_Dinaric",  "Germany", "Italy", "Dog","Romania", "S_Balkan"))

hybrid_labels <- c("BC2d","BC1d","F1","BC1w","BC2w")

wolf_pops <- c(
    "W-Slovenia","W-Croatia","W-Middle_Balkan","W-N.Macedonia",
  "W-Bulgaria","W-Italy","W-Germany","W-Romania"
)

desired_order <- c(
  "Dog","Sim-dog",
  "F1","BC1w","BC2w",
  "W-Slovenia","W-Croatia",
  "W-Middle_Balkan",
  "W-N.Macedonia","Sim-W-N.Macedonia",
  "W-Bulgaria","Sim-W-Bulgaria",
  "W-Italy","Sim-W-Italy",
  "W-Germany","Sim-W-Germany",
  "W-Romania","Sim-W-Romania"
)

thresholds_adj <- c(
  BC2d  = 0.94,
  BC1d  = 0.83,
  F1    = 0.64,
  BC1w  = 0.32,
  BC2w  = 0.12,
  Wolf  = 0.05)

# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD + CLASSIFY ALL SEEDS
# =====================================================
all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed))
  input_file  <- file.path(folder, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file    <- file.path(folder, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=6/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  struct_res    <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input  <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header = FALSE, as.is = TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:11])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend,
                                 by = c("Pop" = "id"))

  structure_results <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog, N_Dinaric, S_Balkan, Italy, Germany, Romania), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["BC2d"] ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["BC1d"] ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["F1"]   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["BC1w"]  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["BC2w"] ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["Wolf"] ~ "BC2w",
        N_Dinaric > 0.8 ~ "N_Dinaric",
        S_Balkan  > 0.8 ~ "S_Balkan",
        Italy     > 0.8 ~ "Italian",
        Germany   > 0.8 ~ "German",
        Romania   > 0.8 ~ "Romanian",
        TRUE ~ "Mixed"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, Dog, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- structure_results
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ EMPIRICAL ONLY + NO DOGS
# =====================================================
all_empirical <- all_classifications %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("^Sim-", pop),
    pop != "Dog"
  )

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ SAMPLE SELECTION
# =====================================================
samples_of_interest <- all_empirical %>%
  mutate(is_hybrid = hy_verdict %in% hybrid_labels) %>%
  group_by(Sample, pop) %>%
  summarise(ever_hybrid = any(is_hybrid), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(
    (pop %in% wolf_pops & ever_hybrid) |
    !(pop %in% wolf_pops)
  )

# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ PIVOT: HYBRID CLASS
# =====================================================
verdict_wide <- all_empirical %>%
  semi_join(samples_of_interest, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  select(Sample, pop, seed, hy_verdict) %>%
  mutate(seed = paste0("Seed", seed, "_class")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = hy_verdict)

# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ PIVOT: qDog
# =====================================================
qdog_wide <- all_empirical %>%
  semi_join(samples_of_interest, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  select(Sample, pop, seed, Dog) %>%
  mutate(seed = paste0("Seed", seed, "_qDog")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = Dog)

# =====================================================
# 6️⃣ FINAL TABLE + ORDERING
# =====================================================
final_hybrid_table <- verdict_wide %>%
  left_join(qdog_wide, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  rename(
    SampleID   = Sample,
    Population = pop
  ) %>%
  arrange(order(factor(Population, levels = desired_order)))

# =====================================================
# 6b COUNT CLASSIFICATIONS ACROSS SEEDS
# =====================================================

# Identify class columns
class_cols <- grep("_class$", names(final_hybrid_table), value = TRUE)

# Convert to long format
class_long <- final_hybrid_table %>%
  select(SampleID, Population, all_of(class_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(class_cols),
    names_to = "Seed",
    values_to = "Class"
  )

# Count classifications per sample
class_counts <- class_long %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Population, Class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# =====================================================
# Keep only the classifications of interest
# =====================================================

# Wolf categories to combine
wolf_categories <- c(
  "N_Dinaric",
  "S_Balkan",
  "Italian",
  "German",
  "Romanian",
  "Mixed"
)

# Hybrid categories to keep separately
hybrid_count_categories <- c(
  "BC2w",
  "BC1w",
  "F1"
)

# =====================================================
# Create counts for BC2w, BC1w and F1
# =====================================================

hybrid_counts_wide <- class_counts %>%
  filter(Class %in% hybrid_count_categories) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Class,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0,
    names_prefix = "n_"
  )

# Make sure all three columns exist
for (x in paste0("n_", hybrid_count_categories)) {
  if (!x %in% names(hybrid_counts_wide)) {
    hybrid_counts_wide[[x]] <- 0L
  }
}

# =====================================================
# Create combined wolf count
# =====================================================

wolf_counts <- class_counts %>%
  filter(Class %in% wolf_categories) %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Population) %>%
  summarise(
    n_wolf = sum(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# =====================================================
# Combine the four count columns
# =====================================================

class_counts_final <- hybrid_counts_wide %>%
  select(
    SampleID,
    Population,
    n_F1,
    n_BC1w,
    n_BC2w
  ) %>%
  full_join(
    wolf_counts,
    by = c("SampleID", "Population")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(n_F1, n_BC1w, n_BC2w, n_wolf),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)
    )
  )

# =====================================================
# Join counts back to main table
# =====================================================

final_hybrid_table <- final_hybrid_table %>%
  left_join(
    class_counts_final,
    by = c("SampleID", "Population")
  )

# =====================================================
# 7️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================
write.xlsx(
  final_hybrid_table,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids/R_results/3b_K6_Empirical_hybrids_and_problematic_wolves_all_seeds.xlsx",
  rowNames = FALSE
)
```

Statistics - Hybrid classification accuracy (K=5)

```{r}
# =====================================================
# SETTINGS
# =====================================================

seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids"

# Number of permutations / Monte Carlo replicates
B <- 9999
set.seed(123)

# Cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Balkan", "Dog", "Italy", "Germany", "Romania"),
  "2" = c("Balkan", "Italy", "Germany", "Dog", "Romania"),
  "3" = c("Germany", "Balkan", "Dog", "Italy", "Romania"),
  "4" = c("Germany", "Balkan", "Dog", "Italy", "Romania"),
  "5" = c("Balkan", "Germany", "Italy", "Dog", "Romania"),
  "6" = c("Balkan", "Germany", "Italy", "Dog", "Romania"),
  "7" = c("Balkan", "Germany", "Dog", "Italy", "Romania"),
  "8" = c("Balkan", "Dog", "Italy", "Germany", "Romania"),
  "9" = c("Balkan", "Italy", "Germany", "Dog", "Romania"),
  "10" = c("Balkan", "Germany", "Italy", "Dog", "Romania")
)

pop_levels <- c(
  "Dog", "Sim-dog",
  "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w",
  "W-Slovenia", "W-Croatia",
  "W-Middle_Balkan",
  "W-N.Macedonia", "Sim-W-N.Macedonia",
  "W-Bulgaria", "Sim-W-Bulgaria",
  "W-Italy", "Sim-W-Italy",
  "W-Germany", "Sim-W-Germany",
  "W-Romania", "Sim-W-Romania"
)

wolf_classes <- c(
  "Balkan", "Italian", "German", "Romanian", "Mixed"
)

expected_cols <- c(
  "Dog", "BC2d", "BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w", "Wolf"
)


# =====================================================
# 1. LOAD + CLASSIFY ALL SEEDS
# =====================================================

all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(
    base_dir,
    paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed)
  )

  input_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed, ".txt")
  )

  pop_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed, "_POP.txt")
  )

  clumpp_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    "Clumpak_results/K=5/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output"
  )

  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input <- read.table(
    input_file,
    skip = 1,
    as.is = TRUE
  )

  struct_legend <- read.table(
    pop_file,
    header = FALSE,
    sep = " ",
    as.is = TRUE
  )

  names(struct_legend) <- c("id", "pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(
    struct_input[, 1:2],
    struct_res[, 6:10]
  )

  structure_results$V2 <- as.character(structure_results$V2)

  names(structure_results) <- c(
    "Sample", "Pop",
    cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]]
  )

  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(
    structure_results,
    struct_legend,
    by = c("Pop" = "id")
  )

  structure_results$pop <- factor(
    structure_results$pop,
    levels = pop_levels
  )


  # -----------------------------------------------------
  # THRESHOLDS
  # -----------------------------------------------------

  thresholds_adj <- c(
    BC2d = 0.94,
    BC1d = 0.83,
    F1 = 0.64,
    BC1w = 0.32,
    BC2w = 0.12,
    Wolf = 0.05
  )

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_F1 <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_wolf <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]


  # -----------------------------------------------------
  # CLASSIFICATION
  # -----------------------------------------------------

  classified <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        c(Dog, Balkan, Italy, Germany, Romania),
        as.numeric
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1 ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        Balkan > 0.8 ~ "Balkan",
        Italy > 0.8 ~ "Italian",
        Germany > 0.8 ~ "German",
        Romania > 0.8 ~ "Romanian",
        TRUE ~ "Mixed"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- classified
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)


# =====================================================
# 2. CALCULATE HYBRID CLASSIFICATION ERROR METRICS
# =====================================================

accuracy_results[["3b_K5"]] <- make_error_metrics(
  all_classifications,
  "3b_empirical_simulation",
  5
)

# =====================================================
# 3️. TEST CONSISTENCY OF ASSIGNMENTS ACROSS SEEDS
# =====================================================

classification_data <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    seed = as.character(seed),
    pop = as.character(pop),
    classified_group = ifelse(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes,
      "Wolf",
      as.character(hy_verdict)
    )
  )


# -----------------------------------------------------
# HELPER FUNCTION: PEARSON CHI-SQUARE STATISTIC
# -----------------------------------------------------

calculate_chisq <- function(tab) {

  expected <- outer(rowSums(tab), colSums(tab)) / sum(tab)

  sum((tab - expected)^2 / expected)
}


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3A. EMPIRICAL POPULATIONS
# Same individuals classified in all 10 seeds
# Within-individual permutation test
# -----------------------------------------------------

empirical_pops <- pop_levels[!grepl("^Sim-", pop_levels)]

empirical_tests <- lapply(empirical_pops, function(pop_name) {

  test_data <- classification_data %>%
    filter(pop == pop_name, !is.na(Sample)) %>%
    arrange(Sample, match(seed, as.character(seeds))) %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    filter(
      n() == length(seeds),
      n_distinct(seed) == length(seeds)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Sample, match(seed, as.character(seeds)))

  n_individuals <- n_distinct(test_data$Sample)

  # Not enough complete individuals
  if (n_individuals < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Empirical",
      n_units = n_individuals,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Within-individual permutation test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: fewer than two individuals"
    ))
  }

  valid_classes <- expected_cols[
    expected_cols %in% unique(test_data$classified_group)
  ]

  # One row per individual, one column per seed
  assignment_matrix <- matrix(
    test_data$classified_group,
    nrow = n_individuals,
    ncol = length(seeds),
    byrow = TRUE
  )

  # Construct observed table in the same order as the matrix:
  # all individuals from seed 1, then seed 2, etc.
  observed_table <- table(
    factor(
      rep(as.character(seeds), each = n_individuals),
      levels = as.character(seeds)
    ),
    factor(
      as.vector(assignment_matrix),
      levels = valid_classes
    )
  )

  # If only one assignment category occurs, there is no
  # variation in assignments to test
if (ncol(observed_table) < 2) {

  return(data.frame(
    pop = pop_name,
    sample_type = "Empirical",
    n_units = n_individuals,
    statistic = NA_real_,
    df = NA_real_,
    p_value = NA_real_,
    test = "Within-individual permutation test",
    test_status = "Not applicable: only one assignment category"
  ))
}

  observed_statistic <- calculate_chisq(observed_table)

  # Permute assignments among seeds within each individual
  null_statistics <- replicate(B, {

    permuted_matrix <- t(apply(
      assignment_matrix,
      1,
      function(x) sample(x, length(x))
    ))

    permuted_assignments <- as.vector(permuted_matrix)

    permuted_table <- table(
      factor(
        rep(as.character(seeds), each = n_individuals),
        levels = as.character(seeds)
      ),
      factor(
        permuted_assignments,
        levels = valid_classes
      )
    )

    calculate_chisq(permuted_table)
  })

  p_value <- (1 + sum(null_statistics >= observed_statistic)) / (B + 1)

  data.frame(
    pop = pop_name,
    sample_type = "Empirical",
    n_units = n_individuals,
    statistic = observed_statistic,
    df = NA_real_,
    p_value = p_value,
    test = "Within-individual permutation test",
    test_status = "Test performed"
  )
})

empirical_tests <- bind_rows(empirical_tests)


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3B. SIMULATED POPULATIONS
# Different simulated individuals in each seed
# Monte Carlo chi-square test of homogeneity
# -----------------------------------------------------

simulated_pops <- pop_levels[grepl("^Sim-", pop_levels)]

simulated_tests <- lapply(simulated_pops, function(pop_name) {

  test_data <- classification_data %>%
    filter(pop == pop_name)

  assignment_table <- table(
    factor(test_data$seed, levels = as.character(seeds)),
    factor(test_data$classified_group, levels = expected_cols)
  )

  # Remove empty rows and columns
  assignment_table <- assignment_table[
    rowSums(assignment_table) > 0,
    colSums(assignment_table) > 0,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  n_observations <- sum(assignment_table)

  # Only one assignment category:
  # no variation to test
  if (ncol(assignment_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Simulated",
      n_units = n_observations,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: only one assignment category"
    ))
  }

  # Fewer than two seeds with observations
  if (nrow(assignment_table) < 2) {

    return(data.frame(
      pop = pop_name,
      sample_type = "Simulated",
      n_units = n_observations,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
      test_status = "Not applicable: fewer than two seeds"
    ))
  }

  test_result <- chisq.test(
    assignment_table,
    simulate.p.value = TRUE,
    B = B
  )

  data.frame(
    pop = pop_name,
    sample_type = "Simulated",
    n_units = n_observations,
    statistic = unname(test_result$statistic),
    df = unname(test_result$parameter),
    p_value = test_result$p.value,
    test = "Monte Carlo chi-square test",
    test_status = "Test performed"
  )
})

simulated_tests <- bind_rows(simulated_tests)


# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3C. COMBINE TESTS AND CORRECT FOR MULTIPLE TESTING
# -----------------------------------------------------

seed_tests <- bind_rows(
  empirical_tests,
  simulated_tests
) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm"),
    significant = case_when(
      is.na(p_adjusted) ~ "Not tested",
      p_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(pop, pop_levels))

base::print(
  as.data.frame(seed_tests),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na.print = "NA"
)

# =====================================================
# 4. CALCULATE % PER SEED
# =====================================================

seed_counts <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels),
    classified_group = ifelse(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes,
      "Wolf",
      hy_verdict
    )
  ) %>%
  count(seed, pop, classified_group) %>%
  complete(
    seed,
    pop = pop_levels,
    classified_group = expected_cols,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(seed, pop) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()


# =====================================================
# 5. PER-SEED TABLES
# =====================================================

seed_tables <- seed_counts %>%
  select(seed, pop, classified_group, percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = percentage,
    values_fill = 0
  )


# =====================================================
# 6. MEAN + SD + SE + CI
# =====================================================

summary_stats <- seed_counts %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(percentage),
    sd = sd(percentage),
    n = n(),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = mean - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    ci_upper = mean + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# --- MEAN ONLY

mean_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = mean,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))


# --- MEAN ± SD

mean_sd_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, sd) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, sd)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_sd_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f ± %.2f",
    mean_sd_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_sd_table[[paste0("sd_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_sd_table <- mean_sd_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# --- MEAN ± SE

mean_se_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, se) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, se)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_se_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f ± %.2f",
    mean_se_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_se_table[[paste0("se_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_se_table <- mean_se_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# --- MEAN ± CI

mean_ci_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, ci_lower, ci_upper) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, ci_lower, ci_upper)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_ci_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_lower_", cls)]],
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_upper_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_ci_table <- mean_ci_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)


# =====================================================
# 7. EXPORT
# =====================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()

# --- Individual seed sheets

for (s in seeds) {

  seed_sheet <- seed_tables %>%
    filter(seed == s) %>%
    mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
    arrange(pop) %>%
    select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0("Seed_", s))
  writeData(wb, paste0("Seed_", s), seed_sheet)
}


# --- Summary sheets

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_only")
writeData(wb, "Mean_only", mean_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SD")

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SE")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SE", mean_se_table)

writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_CI", mean_ci_table)


# --- Seed consistency tests

# --- Save workbook

  "ParallelStructure_Results/3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids/R_results/3b_K5_Hybrid_classification_accuracy_per_seed_1-10_SD_SE_CI.xlsx",
```

Classification and Q_Dog value for empirical hybrids and problematic wolves (K=5)
```{r}
# =====================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =====================================================
seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids"

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Balkan",  "Dog", "Italy", "Germany","Romania"),

  "7" = c("Balkan",  "Germany", "Dog", "Italy","Romania"),
  "8" = c("Balkan",  "Dog", "Italy", "Germany","Romania"),

  "10" = c("Balkan",  "Germany", "Italy", "Dog","Romania")
  )

hybrid_labels <- c("BC2d","BC1d","F1","BC1w","BC2w")

wolf_pops <- c(
    "W-Slovenia","W-Croatia","W-Middle_Balkan","W-N.Macedonia",
  "W-Bulgaria","W-Italy","W-Germany","W-Romania"
)

  "W-Slovenia","W-Croatia",
  "W-Middle_Balkan",
  "W-N.Macedonia","Sim-W-N.Macedonia",
  "W-Bulgaria","Sim-W-Bulgaria",
  "W-Italy","Sim-W-Italy",
  "W-Germany","Sim-W-Germany",
  "W-Romania","Sim-W-Romania"
)

thresholds_adj <- c(
  BC2d  = 0.94,
  BC1d  = 0.83,
  F1    = 0.64,
  BC1w  = 0.32,
  BC2w  = 0.12,
  Wolf  = 0.05)

# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD + CLASSIFY ALL SEEDS
# =====================================================
all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed))
  input_file  <- file.path(folder, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file    <- file.path(folder, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=5/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  struct_res    <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input  <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header = FALSE, as.is = TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:10])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend,
                                 by = c("Pop" = "id"))

  structure_results <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog, Balkan, Italy, Germany, Romania), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["BC2d"] ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["BC1d"] ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["F1"]   ~ "BC1d",
```
