```{r}
# =====================================================
# 4. FUNCTION: READ AND CLASSIFY ONE SEED
# =====================================================

classify_one_seed <- function(configuration, seed) {

  settings <- analysis_settings[[configuration]]

  base_dir <- settings$base_dir
  prefix <- settings$prefix
  k <- settings$k

  folder <- file.path(
    base_dir,
    paste0(prefix, "_", seed)
  )

  input_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    paste0(prefix, "_", seed, ".txt")
  )

  pop_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    paste0(prefix, "_", seed, "_POP.txt")
  )

  clumpp_file <- file.path(
    folder,
    paste0(
      "Clumpak_results/K=", k,
      "/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output"
    )
  )


  # ----------------------------
  # READ STRUCTURE AND CLUMPP FILES
  # ----------------------------

  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)

  struct_input <- read.table(
    input_file,
    skip = 1,
    as.is = TRUE
  )

  struct_legend <- read.table(
    pop_file,
    header = FALSE,
    sep = " ",
    as.is = TRUE
  )

  names(struct_legend) <- c("id", "pop")


  # ----------------------------
  # COMBINE INPUT AND CLUMPP RESULTS
  # ----------------------------

  q_columns <- if (k == 2) {
    6:7
  } else if (k == 5) {
    6:10
  } else {
    6:11
  }

  structure_results <- cbind(
    struct_input[, 1:2],
    struct_res[, q_columns]
  )

  names(structure_results) <- c(
    "Sample",
    "Pop",
    settings$clusters[[as.character(seed)]]
  )

  structure_results$Sample <- as.character(structure_results$Sample)
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(
    structure_results,
    struct_legend,
    by = c("Pop" = "id")
  )

  structure_results$pop <- as.character(structure_results$pop)


  # ----------------------------
  # CHECK DATA CONSISTENCY
  # ----------------------------

  if (anyNA(structure_results$Sample)) {
    stop("Missing Sample IDs in ", configuration, ", seed ", seed)
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(structure_results$Sample)) {
    stop("Duplicated Sample IDs in ", configuration, ", seed ", seed)
  }

  if (anyNA(structure_results$pop)) {
    stop(
      "Some population labels could not be matched in ",
      configuration, ", seed ", seed
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------
  # SET CLASSIFICATION THRESHOLDS
  # ----------------------------

  if (settings$threshold_method == "1c") {

    thresholds <- c(
      BC2d = 0.94,
      BC1d = 0.83,
      F1 = 0.64,
      BC1w = 0.32,
      BC2w = 0.12,
      Wolf = 0.05
    )

  } else if (settings$threshold_method == "fixed") {

    thresholds <- c(
      BC2d = 0.94,
      BC1d = 0.83,
      F1 = 0.64,
      BC1w = 0.32,
      BC2w = 0.12,
      Wolf = 0.05
    )

  } else if (settings$threshold_method == "4a") {

    ref_means <- structure_results %>%
      group_by(pop) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_qDog = mean(as.numeric(Dog), na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    mean_F1 <- mean(
      ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-F1", ref_means$pop)]
    )

    mean_BC1w <- mean(
      ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1w", ref_means$pop)]
    )

    mean_BC2w <- mean(
      ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2w", ref_means$pop)]
    )

    mean_wolf <- mean(
      ref_means$mean_qDog[
        ref_means$pop %in% c(
          "W-Slovenia", "W-Croatia", "W-Middle_Balkan",
          "W-N.Macedonia", "W-Bulgaria", "W-Italy",
          "W-Germany", "W-Romania"
        )
      ]
    )

    thresholds <- c(
      BC2d = 0.94,
      BC1d = 0.83,
      F1 = 0.64,
      BC1w = round(max((mean_F1 + mean_BC1w) / 2, 0.3), 3),
      BC2w = round(max((mean_BC1w + mean_BC2w) / 2, 0.1), 3),
      Wolf = round(max((mean_BC2w + mean_wolf) / 2, 0.05), 3)
    )
  }


  if (any(!is.finite(thresholds))) {
    stop("Non-finite threshold in ", configuration, ", seed ", seed)
  }


  # ----------------------------
  # CLASSIFY INDIVIDUALS
  # ----------------------------

  cluster_columns <- settings$clusters[[as.character(seed)]]

  structure_results <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(cluster_columns), as.numeric))


  if (k == 2) {

    wolf_label <- "N_Dinaric"

    classified <- structure_results %>%
      mutate(
        hy_verdict = case_when(
          Dog >= thresholds["BC2d"] ~ "Dog",
          Dog >= thresholds["BC1d"] ~ "BC2d",
          Dog >= thresholds["F1"] ~ "BC1d",
          Dog >= thresholds["BC1w"] ~ "F1",
          Dog >= thresholds["BC2w"] ~ "BC1w",
          Dog >= thresholds["Wolf"] ~ "BC2w",
          TRUE ~ wolf_label
        )
      )

  } else if (k == 6 && configuration == "3b_K6") {

    classified <- structure_results %>%
      mutate(
        hy_verdict = case_when(
          Dog >= thresholds["BC2d"] ~ "Dog",
          Dog >= thresholds["BC1d"] ~ "BC2d",
          Dog >= thresholds["F1"] ~ "BC1d",
          Dog >= thresholds["BC1w"] ~ "F1",
          Dog >= thresholds["BC2w"] ~ "BC1w",
          Dog >= thresholds["Wolf"] ~ "BC2w",
          N_Dinaric > 0.8 ~ "N_Dinaric",
          S_Balkan > 0.8 ~ "S_Balkan",
          Italy > 0.8 ~ "Italian",
          Germany > 0.8 ~ "German",
          Romania > 0.8 ~ "Romanian",
          TRUE ~ "Mixed"
        )
      )

  } else if (k == 5 && configuration == "3b_K5") {

    classified <- structure_results %>%
      mutate(
        hy_verdict = case_when(
          Dog >= thresholds["BC2d"] ~ "Dog",
          Dog >= thresholds["BC1d"] ~ "BC2d",
          Dog >= thresholds["F1"] ~ "BC1d",
          Dog >= thresholds["BC1w"] ~ "F1",
          Dog >= thresholds["BC2w"] ~ "BC1w",
          Dog >= thresholds["Wolf"] ~ "BC2w",
          Balkan > 0.8 ~ "Balkan",
          Italy > 0.8 ~ "Italian",
          Germany > 0.8 ~ "German",
          Romania > 0.8 ~ "Romanian",
          TRUE ~ "Mixed"
        )
      )

  } else if (k == 6 && configuration == "4a_K6") {

    classified <- structure_results %>%
      mutate(
        hy_verdict = case_when(
          Dog >= thresholds["BC2d"] ~ "Dog",
          Dog >= thresholds["BC1d"] ~ "BC2d",
          Dog >= thresholds["F1"] ~ "BC1d",
          Dog >= thresholds["BC1w"] ~ "F1",
          Dog >= thresholds["BC2w"] ~ "BC1w",
          Dog >= thresholds["Wolf"] ~ "BC2w",
          N_Dinaric > 0.8 ~ "N_Dinaric",
          S_Balkan > 0.8 ~ "S_Balkan",
          Italy > 0.8 ~ "Italian",
          Germany > 0.8 ~ "German",
          Romania > 0.8 ~ "Romanian",
          TRUE ~ "Mixed"
        )
      )

  } else if (k == 5 && configuration == "4a_K5") {

    classified <- structure_results %>%
      mutate(
        hy_verdict = case_when(
          Dog >= thresholds["BC2d"] ~ "Dog",
          Dog >= thresholds["BC1d"] ~ "BC2d",
          Dog >= thresholds["F1"] ~ "BC1d",
          Dog >= thresholds["BC1w"] ~ "F1",
          Dog >= thresholds["BC2w"] ~ "BC1w",
          Dog >= thresholds["Wolf"] ~ "BC2w",
          Balkan > 0.8 ~ "Balkan",
          Italy > 0.8 ~ "Italian",
          Germany > 0.8 ~ "German",
          Romania > 0.8 ~ "Romanian",
          TRUE ~ "Mixed"
        )
      )
  }


  # ----------------------------
  # RETURN INDIVIDUAL CLASSIFICATIONS
  # ----------------------------

  classified %>%
    transmute(
      Sample,
      pop,
      hy_verdict,
      seed,
      configuration
    )
}

# =====================================================
# 9. OVERALL FRIEDMAN TESTS
# =====================================================

run_friedman_test <- function(data, definition, group_name) {

  comparison_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      error_type == definition$error_type,
      pop %in% definition$populations,
      configuration %in% definition$configurations
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, configuration, error_rate)


  # Check that all requested configurations are represented

  missing_configurations <- setdiff(
    definition$configurations,
    unique(comparison_data$configuration)
  )

  if (length(missing_configurations) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing configurations in ", group_name, ": ",
      paste(missing_configurations, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }


  # Check for duplicated individual/configuration combinations

  if (anyDuplicated(comparison_data[c("Sample", "configuration")])) {
    stop(
      "Duplicated individual/configuration records in ",
      group_name
    )
  }


  # Convert to wide format:
  # one row per individual, one column per configuration

  wide_data <- comparison_data %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = configuration,
      values_from = error_rate
    )


  # Keep only individuals with results in every configuration

  wide_complete <- wide_data %>%
    drop_na(all_of(definition$configurations))


  if (nrow(wide_complete) < 2) {
    stop("Too few complete individuals for ", group_name)
  }


  # Create numeric matrix for the Friedman test

  mat <- as.matrix(
    wide_complete[, definition$configurations]
  )


  # Safeguard:
  # If every individual has identical error rates
  # across all configurations, return statistic = 0
  # and p = 1 instead of an undefined result.

  if (all(apply(
    mat,
    1,
    function(r) length(unique(r)) == 1
  ))) {

    return(
      tibble(
        comparison = group_name,
        n_individuals = nrow(wide_complete),
        n_configurations = length(definition$configurations),
        statistic = 0,
        df = length(definition$configurations) - 1,
        p_value = 1,
        status = "No differences: all individuals have identical values across configurations"
      )
    )
  }


  # Friedman test

  test <- friedman.test(mat)


  tibble(
    comparison = group_name,
    n_individuals = nrow(wide_complete),
    n_configurations = length(definition$configurations),
    statistic = unname(test$statistic),
    df = unname(test$parameter),
    p_value = test$p.value,
    status = "Test performed"
  )
}

# =====================================================
# 10. PAIRWISE PAIRED WILCOXON SIGNED-RANK TESTS
# =====================================================

compare_two_configurations <- function(data, config1, config2) {

  data1 <- data %>%
    filter(configuration == config1) %>%
    select(Sample, error_rate) %>%
    rename(error_1 = error_rate)

  data2 <- data %>%
    filter(configuration == config2) %>%
    select(Sample, error_rate) %>%
    rename(error_2 = error_rate)


  # Check that each individual occurs only once
  # in each configuration

  if (anyDuplicated(data1$Sample) || anyDuplicated(data2$Sample)) {
    stop("Duplicated Sample IDs in pairwise comparison.")
  }


  # Match the same individuals between configurations

  matched <- inner_join(
    data1,
    data2,
    by = "Sample"
  )


  differences <- matched$error_2 - matched$error_1

  n_matched <- nrow(matched)


  # Negative = lower error rate in configuration 2
  # Positive = higher error rate in configuration 2

  n_lower <- sum(differences < 0)
  n_equal <- sum(differences == 0)
  n_higher <- sum(differences > 0)


  # Handle insufficient data or identical paired values

  if (n_matched < 2) {

    W_value <- NA_real_
    p_value <- NA_real_
    test_status <- "Not tested: fewer than two matched individuals"

  } else if (all(differences == 0)) {

    W_value <- 0
    p_value <- 1
    test_status <- "No differences: all paired values identical"

  } else {

    # Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test

    test <- wilcox.test(
      matched$error_1,
      matched$error_2,
      paired = TRUE,
      alternative = "two.sided",
      exact = FALSE,
      correct = TRUE
    )

    W_value <- unname(test$statistic)
    p_value <- test$p.value
    test_status <- "Test performed"
  }


  tibble(
    analysis_1 = config1,
    analysis_2 = config2,
    n_matched = n_matched,
    n_lower = n_lower,
    n_equal = n_equal,
    n_higher = n_higher,
    median_difference = if (n_matched > 0) {
      median(differences)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    W = W_value,
    p_value = p_value,
    status = test_status
  )
}


# =====================================================
# 11. RUN ALL PAIRWISE COMPARISONS WITHIN EACH GROUP
# =====================================================

run_comparison_group <- function(definition, group_name) {

  comparison_data <- individual_error_rates %>%
    filter(
      error_type == definition$error_type,
      pop %in% definition$populations,
      configuration %in% definition$configurations
    )


  # Confirm that all requested configurations are represented

  missing_configurations <- setdiff(
    definition$configurations,
    unique(comparison_data$configuration)
  )

  if (length(missing_configurations) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing configurations in ", group_name, ": ",
      paste(missing_configurations, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }


  # Generate all pairwise comparisons

  pairs <- combn(
    definition$configurations,
    2,
    simplify = FALSE
  )


  results <- map_dfr(
    pairs,
    ~ compare_two_configurations(
      comparison_data,
      .x[1],
      .x[2]
    )
  )


  # Holm correction across pairwise comparisons
  # within each comparison group

  results %>%
    mutate(
      comparison = group_name,
      p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm"),
      .before = 1
    )
}


# Run all three comparison groups

pairwise_results <- imap_dfr(
  comparison_definitions,
  run_comparison_group
)


print(pairwise_results, n = Inf)

  )


# =====================================================
# 13. FORMAT PAIRWISE RESULTS FOR EXPORT
# =====================================================

pairwise_results_export <- pairwise_results %>%
  mutate(
    median_difference_percent = median_difference * 100,

    significant = case_when(
      is.na(p_adjusted) ~ NA_character_,
      p_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    ),

    test_used = case_when(
      status == "Test performed" ~
        "Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test (two-sided, exact = FALSE, continuity correction = TRUE)",

      status == "No differences: all paired values identical" ~
        "Not performed: all paired values identical",

      TRUE ~ status
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    comparison,
    analysis_1,
    analysis_2,
    n_matched,
    n_lower,
    n_equal,
    n_higher,
    median_difference_percent,
    W,
    p_value,
    p_adjusted,
    significant,
    status,
    test_used
  )

print(individual_error_summary, n = Inf)

print(pairwise_results_export, n = Inf)

print(friedman_results, n = Inf)
```

4.2  Compared assignment accuracy among the four population-openness analyses (2ai, 2aii, 2bi and 2bii)
```{r}
# =====================================================
# 1. PREPARE SEED-LEVEL FNR AND FPR VALUES
# =====================================================

metrics_all <- bind_rows(accuracy_results) %>%
  mutate(
    configuration = as.character(configuration),
    K = as.character(K),
    seed = as.character(seed),
    data_type = as.character(data_type),
    sample_group = as.character(sample_group)
  )

metrics_long <- metrics_all %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(FNR, FPR),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "error_rate"
  ) %>%
  filter(K == "2")


# =====================================================
# 2. CHECK THAT THERE IS ONLY ONE VALUE PER SEED
# =====================================================

duplicate_check <- metrics_long %>%
  count(configuration, K, seed, data_type, sample_group, metric) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(duplicate_check) > 0) {
  print(duplicate_check)
  stop("There are duplicate seed-level error rates. Check accuracy_results.")
}


# =====================================================
# 3. DEFINE THE COMPARISONS
# =====================================================

comparison_plan <- tribble(
  ~comparison, ~analysis_1, ~analysis_2, ~metric, ~data_type, ~group_1, ~group_2,

  # Croatia: low vs high
  "Croatia: low vs high", "2ai_Croatia_low", "2bi_Croatia_high",
  "FNR", "Empirical", "Hybrids", "Hybrids",

  "Croatia: low vs high", "2ai_Croatia_low", "2bi_Croatia_high",
  "FPR", "Empirical", "Croatia", "Croatia",

  "Croatia: low vs high", "2ai_Croatia_low", "2bi_Croatia_high",
  "FNR", "Simulated", "Simulated", "Simulated",

  "Croatia: low vs high", "2ai_Croatia_low", "2bi_Croatia_high",
  "FPR", "Simulated", "Simulated", "Simulated",


  # High sample size: Croatia vs Italy
  "High sample size: Croatia vs Italy", "2bi_Croatia_high", "2bii_Italy_high",
  "FPR", "Empirical", "Croatia", "Italy",

  "High sample size: Croatia vs Italy", "2bi_Croatia_high", "2bii_Italy_high",
  "FNR", "Simulated", "Simulated", "Simulated",

  "High sample size: Croatia vs Italy", "2bi_Croatia_high", "2bii_Italy_high",
  "FPR", "Simulated", "Simulated", "Simulated",


  # Italy: low vs high
  "Italy: low vs high", "2aii_Italy_low", "2bii_Italy_high",
  "FPR", "Empirical", "Italy", "Italy",

  "Italy: low vs high", "2aii_Italy_low", "2bii_Italy_high",
  "FNR", "Simulated", "Simulated", "Simulated",

  "Italy: low vs high", "2aii_Italy_low", "2bii_Italy_high",
  "FPR", "Simulated", "Simulated", "Simulated",


  # Low sample size: Croatia vs Italy
  "Low sample size: Croatia vs Italy", "2ai_Croatia_low", "2aii_Italy_low",
  "FPR", "Empirical", "Croatia", "Italy",

  "Low sample size: Croatia vs Italy", "2ai_Croatia_low", "2aii_Italy_low",
  "FNR", "Simulated", "Simulated", "Simulated",

  "Low sample size: Croatia vs Italy", "2ai_Croatia_low", "2aii_Italy_low",
  "FPR", "Simulated", "Simulated", "Simulated"
)

comparison_plan <- comparison_plan %>%
  mutate(
    group_1 = if_else(group_1 == "Italy", "Other wolves", group_1),
    group_2 = if_else(group_2 == "Italy", "Other wolves", group_2)
  )

# =====================================================
# 4. FUNCTION TO EXTRACT SEED-LEVEL ERROR RATES
# =====================================================
get_seed_rates <- function(configuration, data_type, sample_group, metric) {

  metrics_long %>%
    filter(
      .data$configuration == .env$configuration,
      .data$data_type == .env$data_type,
      .data$sample_group == .env$sample_group,
      .data$metric == .env$metric,
      !is.na(error_rate)
    ) %>%
    arrange(as.numeric(seed)) %>%
    pull(error_rate)
}


# =====================================================
# 5. FUNCTION TO COMPARE TWO ANALYSES
# =====================================================

run_comparison <- function(
    comparison,
    analysis_1,
    analysis_2,
    metric,
    data_type,
    group_1,
    group_2
) {

  x <- get_seed_rates(
    analysis_1, data_type, group_1, metric
  )

  y <- get_seed_rates(
    analysis_2, data_type, group_2, metric
  )

  n_1 <- length(x)
  n_2 <- length(y)

  # Not enough observations
  if (n_1 < 2 || n_2 < 2) {

    return(tibble(
      comparison = comparison,
      analysis_1 = analysis_1,
      analysis_2 = analysis_2,
      metric = metric,
      data_type = data_type,
      sample_category_1 = group_1,
      sample_category_2 = group_2,
      n_1 = n_1,
      n_2 = n_2,
      mean_error_1 = if (n_1 > 0) mean(x) else NA_real_,
      mean_error_2 = if (n_2 > 0) mean(y) else NA_real_,
      mean_difference = NA_real_,
      median_difference = NA_real_,
      test = "Unpaired Wilcoxon rank-sum test",
      p_value = NA_real_,
      status = "Not tested: fewer than two observations"
    ))
  }

  # Wilcoxon rank-sum test
  test_result <- wilcox.test(
    x,
    y,
    paired = FALSE,
    alternative = "two.sided",
    exact = FALSE,
    correct = FALSE
  )

  tibble(
    comparison = comparison,
    analysis_1 = analysis_1,
    analysis_2 = analysis_2,
    metric = metric,
    data_type = data_type,
    sample_category_1 = group_1,
    sample_category_2 = group_2,
    n_1 = n_1,
    n_2 = n_2,
    mean_error_1 = mean(x),
    mean_error_2 = mean(y),
    mean_difference = mean(y) - mean(x),
    median_difference = median(y) - median(x),
    test = "Unpaired Wilcoxon rank-sum test",
    p_value = test_result$p.value,
    status = "Test performed"
  )
}


# =====================================================
# 6. RUN ALL COMPARISONS
# =====================================================

comparison_results <- pmap_dfr(
  comparison_plan,
  run_comparison
)


# =====================================================
# 7. HOLM CORRECTION
# Separately for FNR and FPR
# =====================================================

comparison_results <- comparison_results %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm"),

    significance = case_when(
      is.na(p_adjusted) ~ "Not tested",
      p_adjusted < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(
    factor(metric, levels = c("FNR", "FPR")),
    match(
      comparison,
      c(
        "Croatia: low vs high",
        "High sample size: Croatia vs Italy",
        "Italy: low vs high",
        "Low sample size: Croatia vs Italy"
      )
    ),
    data_type
  )


# =====================================================
# 8. PRINT RESULTS
# =====================================================

print(
  as.data.frame(comparison_results),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# =====================================================
# 9. EXPORT TO EXCEL
# =====================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "All_comparisons")
writeData(wb, "All_comparisons", comparison_results)

addWorksheet(wb, "FNR")
writeData(
  wb,
  "FNR",
  comparison_results %>% filter(metric == "FNR")
)

addWorksheet(wb, "FPR")
writeData(
  wb,
  "FPR",
  comparison_results %>% filter(metric == "FPR")
)

addWorksheet(wb, "Seed_level_values")
writeData(wb, "Seed_level_values", metrics_long)

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/Comparison/Comparison_2ai_2aii_2bi_2bii.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```
